record.description: A two-level cat window perch that suction-mounts to glass windows so cats can lounge in sunlight and watch outdoors. The metal frame has a cat-face design, and the plush mattress comes off for machine washing. Adjustable height lets cats stand on the lower layer and climb up easily.
Black women's wrap slipper from Merrell, listed in size 5.0 M US. Its Select GRIP outsole is built to provide durable traction that grips when and where it is needed.

specs.care: Machine washable cold, gentle cycle, tumble dry low

record.description: A long buffalo plaid table runner with a farmhouse look, suited to banquet, dining, or buffet tables. Made from a cotton and polyester blend, it is machine washable and suited to holidays, parties, weddings, and everyday use indoors or outdoors.

specs.package dimensions: 2.8 L x 4.8 W x 13 H cm

record.description: A black linerlock item from the Harley Tec X line, sold under the Case name. It ships in a compact package measuring about 13 centimeters tall and weighing roughly 0.14 kilograms. Made in China.

An indoor stationary exercise bike for cardio training at home. A 30-pound flywheel provides resistance that you adjust by hand, and the padded seat and handlebars can be positioned to fit your height and arm length. Built-in holders keep a water bottle and your phone within reach during workouts.

specs.straps: Adjustable S-shape shoulder straps with top handle

record.description: A lightweight camouflage backpack sized for elementary school students. It offers several compartments, including a laptop sleeve and a small zippered pouch, plus mesh side pockets that suit a water bottle. Padded adjustable straps and a top handle make it easy to carry.

specs.size: 52 x 84 inches per panel, set of 2
specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: Linen-blend curtain panels with a soft, airy texture and a natural, relaxed look. They diffuse daylight while offering some privacy. Each panel hangs from nickel grommets and suits standard rods. Sold as a set of two.

A single 0.4 fl oz bottle from Sally Hansen's Xtreme Wear line, in the Iris Illusion shade. The listing promotes a durable, hard-wearing finish with strong color and shine, and a current on-trend shade.

specs.dimensions: 8 in L x 6.75 in W x 16.5 in H
specs.care: Wipe with damp cloth, towel dry

record.description: A countertop mug tree that stores six mugs or teacups vertically by their handles, freeing up cabinet space. Its curved branches hold cups of various sizes and shapes in place. The looped top makes it easy to carry between spots, and a black finish suits a range of kitchen styles.

specs.fit features: Flex elbow, back bi-swing between shoulders

record.description: A men's Carhartt jacket in a shadow shade, sized medium. It has a water-repellent finish for light rain and stretch fabric that allows easy movement. Its back panel and elbow design aim to reduce restriction while moving.

specs.included: 1 laundry basket and 2 removable laundry bags

record.description: A tall, foldable laundry hamper with a handle and two removable bags so dirty clothes can be carried away and swapped quickly. Its sturdy Oxford fabric and fiber rods help it keep its shape, and it folds flat for travel, dorms, or small spaces.

A collectible prize figure of Echidna from the anime series Re:Zero, sculpted in a Mandarin dress outfit. Made by Taito as an officially licensed product, it comes with a base stand for display on a shelf or desk.

A women's black down jacket from Columbia with 700 fill power goose down insulation and a waterproof, breathable, fully seam-sealed shell. It has a removable, helmet-compatible hood, underarm venting, a zippered waist pocket, and an adjustable hem.

specs.material: Combed cotton with rubber anti-slip grips
specs.grip style: Round dotted grips, sized smaller at edges
specs.cuff: Heel tabs and non-tight ankle elastic

record.description: Non-slip socks for infants and toddlers, with rubber dot grips on the soles to help little ones steady themselves while walking, crawling, or playing on slides. Made from medium-weight combed cotton that stays breathable and stretchy, with a loose ankle cuff and heel tabs for easy on and off. Sold in an assorted-color value pack.

specs.subject: Edward Hopper, People in the Sun

record.description: Canvas wall art reproducing Edward Hopper's People in the Sun, printed in high definition with vivid colors. Suited to living rooms, bedrooms, offices, and cafes. Ships unframed, with each panel individually packaged.

A fitted grey dress shirt from Van Heusen in a solid poplin weave. It has a point collar, adjustable two-button cuffs, and a chest pocket. The wrinkle-resistant fabric is designed for easy care and a tapered waist.

Red steel wagon with rubber tires for hauling toddlers, gardening soil, and everyday cargo. The pull handle folds under the body for storage, and a controlled turning radius helps prevent tipping. Recommended for ages 1.5 and up.

specs.straps: Back adjustable, convertible traditional or crisscross

record.description: A wirefree everyday bra offering full coverage in lightly lined cups. Silky, smooth fabric gives a sleek look under clothing, and convertible back straps let you wear it traditional or crisscross.

specs.material: Wheat straw fiber and food-grade PP

record.description: A set of four lightweight, unbreakable cereal bowls made from wheat straw fiber and food-grade PP. Holds 24 ounces, suitable for cereal, salad, fruit, rice, or noodles. Dishwasher and microwave safe, with smooth rounded edges and deep sides to help keep food from splashing out.

A dark blue cake topper with a large sparkling number One, designed for a baby boy's first birthday. Arrives pre-assembled so it can be placed directly on a cake. Also works as a prop for cake smash photos.

Self-lubricating flanged sleeve bearing made from sintered bronze, in the SAE 841 Oilite grade. Its copper color and mostly copper makeup give it good wear resistance, ductility, and corrosion resistance. Suited to general-purpose uses with moderate speeds and loads.

specs.media handling: Sheet feed; roll feed; input tray; automatic cutter

record.description: A compact large-format plotter for architects, engineers, and builders working in home or small offices. It supports sheets and rolls, includes an automatic cutter, and connects by Ethernet, USB, or Wi-Fi. Mobile printing is available through apps on Android, Chrome OS, iOS, and HP Smart.

A five-pack of sleeveless white bodysuits for babies sized 6 to 12 months. The 4-way stretch fabric is soft and flexible, moving with the wearer. Expandable shoulders make dressing easier, and reinforced snaps are meant to hold up over repeated washing.

A set of three stainless steel mixing bowls in 1.5, 3, and 5 quart sizes for whisking, mixing, marinating, and serving. The lightweight bowls stack for compact storage and can be washed in the dishwasher, refrigerated, or frozen.

specs.care: Machine washable or hand washable

record.description: A summer short dress for women with a V neckline, short butterfly sleeves, and a high-waisted A-line cut. The all-over print suits casual and everyday wear. Fabric has no stretch. Machine or hand washable. Consult the size chart before ordering.

A green cactus-patterned lanyard with a matching ID badge holder, made from soft polyester with printing on both sides. It has a metal clasp for keys and holds two ID cards. A practical accessory for work or school, and a simple gift option.

specs.care: Wash in normal temperature water

record.description: Women's short-sleeve graphic tee with a playful Halloween letter print and a Sanderson Sisters design. Made from a cotton blend for a soft, stretchy, breathable feel, with a loose casual cut and round neckline. Suits spring, fall, and winter and pairs easily with jeans or leggings.

A slim women's bifold wallet made from cowhide leather with an embossed checkered pattern. It includes card slots, a photo slot, a coin pocket, and a full-length bill compartment. A built-in RFID-blocking layer is designed to help guard cards against unauthorized scans. Compact enough for a coat pocket or cross-body bag.

Roll-up travel storage bags that push out air without a vacuum, letting you pack more into a suitcase or carry-on. The set includes three large suitcase bags and five medium carry-on bags. Useful for coats, laundry, and soiled items, and designed to help guard against bugs, moths, dirt, mildew, and odors.

specs.features: Rearfoot GEL cushioning; removable sockliner

record.description: A women's running shoe for moderate mileage, with rearfoot and forefoot gel cushioning to soften impact and a durable outsole built for high-wear areas. The sockliner can be removed to make room for a medical orthotic.

specs.dimensions: Approx. 43.98 in H x 15.87 in W x 13.5 in D

record.description: A white three-cube storage organizer with an open back and a sturdy frame. Each cube is compatible with 13-inch fabric storage bins. It can be displayed upright or on its side, and it comes with all hardware for simple assembly.

specs.material: Patent PU leather with soft polyester lining

record.description: A solid brown flap satchel with a glossy patent finish and a retro look that suits dresses, skirts, and other outfits. It has a magnetic snap plus zipper closure, a reinforced base, and room for a phone, wallet, sunglasses, and makeup. It can be carried by hand, on the shoulder, or crossbody with the removable chain strap.

specs.features: Wireless charging compatible, precise cutouts

record.description: A slim protective case designed for the iPhone XR. The back panel has a matte, non-slip finish, while the soft TPU sides help absorb drops and bumps. Cutouts keep buttons and ports easy to reach without removing the case, and the front bevel helps guard the screen.

specs.style: Short sleeve bodysuit with lap shoulder and snap crotch
specs.made in: Printed and shipped in Austin, TX, USA

record.description: A black short-sleeve baby bodysuit featuring a retro 90s sitcom quote print. Made from soft, pre-shrunk ring-spun cotton with a snap crotch for easy changes. Printed in Austin, Texas, and suited to birthdays, baby showers, and new arrival gifts.
Women's western cowboy boot from Ariat in a brown colorway with a floral pattern. Features a Duratread outsole and comes in US women's size 11 M.

Motorized running boards that extend when the door opens and retract when it closes. Includes an integrated low-profile LED light. Made of die-cast aluminum with a corrosion-resistant coated finish, and built for use in all weather conditions.

A thin box chain necklace made from sterling silver with a rhodium plating for a bright, polished look. Its lobster claw clasp offers a secure closure, and the lightweight design sits comfortably at the collarbone for everyday wear or layering with pendants.
A large shark-shaped pencil eraser in green, designed for correcting bigger mistakes on schoolwork, homework, or office paperwork. It also makes a fun back-to-school gift idea.

A short-sleeved midi dress with a navy striped pattern and a fitted sheath silhouette. It has cap sleeves, a round neckline, and a concealed back zipper. Made of polyester with some stretch. Sizing runs slightly small, so consider sizing up if between sizes.

Replacement aerator for Delta Neo Style lavatory faucets, limiting water flow to 2.2 gallons per minute. Features a chrome finish and a 55/64 inch by 27 female thread for installation on compatible bathroom sink faucets.

specs.care: Machine washable and dryer safe

record.description: A lightweight button-up shirt for men, blending linen and cotton for breathability in warm weather. Its narrow collar and rolled sleeves suit everything from business casual to weekend wear. Tailored with a trim chest and torso and fitted shoulders, it is designed to be easy to care for in a home washer and dryer.

specs.fit: Close to the body, slim silhouette

record.description: A men's lightweight T-shirt with a slim, close-to-the-body fit and a V-neckline. Made from soft jersey slub cotton, it includes a pocket and comes in a pampas yellow shade in size large.

A black rubber ramp-style floor mat with a textured surface to help reduce slipping on inclined paths, walkways, boat docks, and entryways. It is lightweight, easy to move and install, and suited to commercial or high-traffic areas.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, tumble dry low

record.description: A white cotton throw with decorative fringe and a vintage-inspired look. Its 50 by 60 inch size works well over a couch or chair for extra warmth, and it suits picnics, camping, and gift wrapping.

specs.care: Hand wash with mild detergent

record.description: A heavyweight aluminum pan for baking classic angel food cakes. Its nonstick coating helps cakes release easily and simplifies cleanup. The metal conducts heat gently and evenly for a consistent bake. Hand washing with mild detergent is recommended.

specs.back material: Hard plastic back with flexible silicone bumper

record.description: A slim, transparent protective case for the iPhone 11 Pro Max. It pairs a hard back with a soft silicone bumper for a firm grip, and reinforced corners aim to absorb drops. The clear design shows the phone's original finish, and it is designed to work with most wireless chargers.

specs.outsole: Direct injected one-component PU with shock point

record.description: A men's black oxford shoe from ECCO with a bike-toe shape, blind-eyelet lacing, and double-stitched seams. The lining wicks moisture, and the comfort fibre system is meant to keep feet ventilated. Sized 45 EU, roughly US men's 11 to 11.5.

specs.included: 4-inch and 12-inch extensions, 4 spindle rods, 4 wall cups

record.description: A steel pressure-mount safety gate with a walk-through door for doorways, hallways, and the bottom of stairs. It adjusts to openings of about 29 to 47 inches and stands 30 inches tall. Includes extension kits, wall cups, and mounting hardware. Intended for children roughly 6 to 24 months old.
Men's low-cut soccer boot built for artificial turf play. Features a regular fit and a 3D-printed strike zone. Finished in black, white, and red.

specs.accessories: 3 ropes (5 ft each), stainless steel D-rings on each side
specs.installation: Recommended 20-40 degree angle with maximum tension

record.description: A triangular sun shade sail for patios, gardens, pools, and BBQ areas. Made from high density polyethylene, it blocks up to 95% of UV rays while letting air and water pass through. Includes ropes and metal D-rings for mounting, and is designed to be set up and taken down easily.

specs.fit: High waisted flare palazzo wide leg
specs.care: Hand wash cold, do not bleach, hang dry

record.description: High waisted flare palazzo pants with a wide leg silhouette and a supportive waistband that sits comfortably. Made from soft peachskin fabric with a bit of stretch for everyday comfort. Hand wash cold and hang dry.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle; sun-dry or tumble dry low

record.description: A reversible queen comforter set with two solid colors on opposite sides, filled with polyester for a soft, warm feel. Includes two matching pillow shams. Made to be machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle.

specs.light_source: CREE XM-L T6 LED, max 800 lumens
specs.beam_distance: Up to 20+ feet on brightest setting

record.description: A bright, zoomable LED headlamp with high, low and strobe modes for running, hiking, camping, fishing and home repairs. Its elastic headband is easy to adjust, and the head tilts 90 degrees for directed light. Splash-resistant, but not for submersion.

Keto-friendly vanilla-coated wafer crisps with a lemon filling, packed in a box of five. Each crisp provides 11 grams of protein and 5 grams of fiber, with low sugar and net carbs, making it a satisfying snack for low-carb eating.

Women's mid-rise bootcut jeans with a stretchy cotton and Lycra blend for comfortable all-day wear. Flame-resistant construction is rated to NFPA 70E, NFPA 2112, and CAT 2 standards for hazardous work settings. Finished with an embroidered back pocket and an entwined print.

specs.material: Wool-like plush fleece lining, plush upper
specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Slip-on women's house slippers with a soft fleece lining and a high-density memory foam insole for cushioned comfort. The rubber sole offers traction for indoor and outdoor use. Machine washable and suited to everyday wear at home.

Relaxed-fit carpenter jeans from Dickies in a soft, garment-washed lightweight cotton duck. Features deep front and back pockets, a utility pocket, a hammer loop, and triple-stitched seams. Straight leg sits comfortably over boots.

A matching his and hers wedding and engagement ring set in polished stainless steel. The women's ring has a prong-set round cut cubic zirconia center stone, and the men's band is a comfort-fit design about 8mm wide. The rings are nickel free and resist tarnishing, and they arrive in a gift box.

specs.compatibility: Binoculars without a threaded tripod socket

record.description: A universal mount that lets binoculars without a built-in threaded tripod socket attach to a standard tripod. It uses a common 1/4-inch-20 screw thread and fits a wide range of binocular models.

specs.type: Spa thong slipper (flip flop style, open toe)
specs.width: Wide widths available in Black and Natural
specs.care: Machine wash and dry

record.description: A women's house slipper in a classic flip flop design with a soft terry upper and a memory foam footbed for heel and arch support. The anti-skid rubber sole suits indoor and outdoor wear, and the slipper is lightweight and easy to pack for travel or the gym.

specs.features: Arch support, turn welt top, non-cushion
specs.yarn: High performance yarns with moisture management and odor control

record.description: Moderate graduated compression sock for women, designed for everyday wear, travel, and long periods of sitting or standing. Offers 15-20 mmHg pressure across four zones, with a seamless toe, arch support, and a non-cushion knit. Sized M/L for US shoe sizes 8 to 11.

A women's loose-fitting tunic top with three-quarter roll-tab sleeves and a notched V-neckline. Its high-low hem drapes over leggings or jeans, and the soft, stretchy fabric suits everyday wear, church, or a picnic.

A black luggage strap that cinches around suitcases to make them easier to spot on a carousel. Its polypropylene strap adjusts to fit bags up to 72 inches, and the ABS buckle is designed to stand up to rough baggage handling.

A classic Western-style ankle bootie with a V cutout at the front, a low stacked block heel, and an inner zip for easy on and off. Lightly padded footbed suits all-day wear. Made with man-made materials throughout.

A set of 69 Futurama-themed PVC stickers for decorating laptops, backpacks, skateboards, luggage, and bicycles. Sized roughly one to three inches each, the set suits kids, teens, and adults who want playful cartoon decals.

specs.fit: Relaxed; consider ordering a size up

record.description: Women's strappy sandals with lightweight LiteRide foam insoles for a soft, cushioned feel. The Croslite foam outsole is designed for everyday support, and the flexible gore upper is meant to feel comfortable from the first wear.

specs.paper: High quality paper stock from well-managed forests

record.description: A humorous Hallmark Shoebox birthday card for a friend or relative, with a modern sunrise cover design and an irreverent, laugh-out-loud message inside. Comes with a matching envelope.

specs.care: Machine washable after removing insole

record.description: Slip-on flats with a knit upper, cotton-lined interior, and cushioned removable leather insole. Jelly outsole aims for slip resistance. Designed for everyday wear, including commuting and walking. Gold cap and parrot green colorway in EU size 35. Insole can be removed for machine washing.
A lightweight graphic t-shirt themed around Switzerland and the Swiss Alps, with a classic fit and double-needle stitching at the sleeves and hem. Suited to hiking, travel, or as a souvenir or gift.

specs.use: Insulating heating and AC ducts and pipes
specs.installation: No gloves, face mask, or goggles needed

record.description: Foil-backed cotton wrap for insulating and cushioning pipes and heating or air conditioning ducts. It carries a Class A fire rating and can be installed without gloves, a face mask, or goggles. It also helps reduce vibration along ductwork. Supplied as a 25-foot roll.

specs.dimensions: approx. 20 x 30 x 35 cm (W x H x D)

record.description: An espresso and cappuccino machine with a brushed stainless-steel finish and red accents. It has a steam nozzle for frothing milk and a removable drip tray with a stainless-steel grid. The removable water tank holds about 1.3 quarts for several cups.

A 20-inch freestyle BMX bike from Dynacraft. It includes a freestyle rotor, front and rear U-brakes, and pegs at both ends of the frame. The 48-spoke wheels and deluxe paint finish round out the build.

specs.material: High density fiberboard and solid wood veneer
specs.lid: Locking top lid with vanity mirror

record.description: A walnut-finish jewelry armoire with a locking top lid, side doors fitted with double-tiered necklace hooks, and eight pull-out drawers for storage. The lid holds ring rolls, a divided compartment, and a vanity mirror.

specs.capacity: Up to 4 children at once; 300 lbs total
specs.included: Carry bag, repair kit, 5 stakes, 2 hoses

record.description: An inflatable water park for kids that combines a splash pool, water cannon, two slides and a climbing wall in one unit. Its puncture-resistant PVC-coated fabric and safety netting are meant for supervised play indoors or outdoors. It inflates in minutes, folds into a compact bag, and needs a separate blower.

A wired optical computer mouse with three buttons and a rubber scroll wheel for everyday office and home use. It offers 1000 DPI tracking and a plug-and-play USB connection that needs no driver. The mouse has a rainbow LED light and a 1.6 meter cable. It is compatible with Windows and Mac computers, laptops, and notebooks.

specs.style: Joan of Arctic Shearling mid calf boot

record.description: A waterproof mid-calf winter boot from Sorel with suede leather uppers, a soft shearling cuff, and a warm faux fur lining. The vulcanized rubber shell and seam-sealed construction help keep out rain and snow, while a bonded felt frost plug adds insulation underfoot.

specs.backing: Metallic film strip, no paper backing

record.description: Individual faux mink lash extensions for salon use, offered in CC curl with a range of lengths and thicknesses. The strips use a metallic film backing instead of paper, which the maker says leaves less residue. Intended for lash artists who want quick application and longer wear.

A two-pack of men's long sleeve tees from Gildan in a heathered sport grey. The fabric is designed to help keep the wearer cool and wick moisture away. Features include reinforced neck tape, cuffs with added stretch, and side seams that stay straight after washing.

A supportive minimizer underwire bra in a soft body beige tone. Its smoothing fabric and two-layer back help shape the figure, while wider straps and a more open underwire aim to keep wear comfortable. The open neckline offers balanced coverage.

A folding incline wedge mat for gymnastics, tumbling, stretching, yoga, and aerobics. Its trapezoidal shape lets several mats stack for storage. The removable zip-seal cover makes cleaning simple, and the anti-tear fabric is built for frequent use.

A wearable swaddle sack for newborns and infants up to about three months old. Arms can be placed inside, outside, or one of each. A bottom zipper allows diaper changes without unwrapping the baby, and adjustable hook-and-loop wings help achieve a snug fit.

A small pendant charm in the shape of the number 1, crafted from 14k white gold with a brushed finish. Laser cut and sized for a delicate necklace, it makes a thoughtful keepsake gift for a special occasion.

A slim, clear protective case for iPhone X and XS with D3O impact material to absorb knocks and drops. Bevelled edges add protection around the phone, and a UV scratch-resistant coating adds further protection. Precision cut-outs leave buttons and ports easy to reach.

Warm ankle boots for women designed for fall and winter wear. Faux leather uppers with a cozy lining, padded collar, and quilted side panels. Rubber soles aim to offer stable footing on slippery surfaces.

Men's classic five-pocket denim jeans with a slim fit through the thigh that widens to a bootcut leg. The stretch fabric adds comfort and helps the jeans keep their shape for everyday wear. Sits below the waist in a black wash.

Timex women's watch with a reversible nylon slip-thru strap: blue on one side, white and yellow floral swirl print on the other. Round white dial shows Arabic numerals and 24-hour military time, plus an Indiglo light. Polished silver-tone 38mm case, water resistant to 30 meters for splashes and brief immersion, not swimming.

specs.features: Cargo pockets, scissors pocket, D-ring at left leg

record.description: Women's cargo-style scrub pants with a low rise and drawstring waistband for an adjustable fit. Multiple pockets include one sized for scissors, and a D-ring on the left leg adds convenience. Adjustable toggles at the ankles complete the design.

specs.care: No hot water or alkaline detergent; wash separately; hang to dry

record.description: A one-piece swimsuit for little girls with a playful printed pattern. Made from a soft, stretchy polyamide and elastane blend that dries fairly quickly and allows free movement. Suited to pool parties, beach days, bath time, and photos. Hang to dry and wash separately.

specs.features: Lightweight, double-needle sleeve and bottom hem

record.description: A lightweight, classic-fit t-shirt themed on Miles Morales from Marvel's Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse. Officially licensed Marvel apparel with double-needle stitching at the sleeves and bottom hem.

specs.washability: Washes out with shampoo and water
specs.hair suitability: Best on light hair such as gray and blond

record.description: A set of ten bright temporary hair chalks paired with a comb for quick, non-permanent color changes. Colors can be used alone or blended, and they rinse out with shampoo and water. Works best on light hair, and can be suited to parties, cosplay, or dress-up play.

Women's no-show liner socks in a three-pair pack, finished in black. The mesh top allows airflow, the cushioned ventilated sole adds comfort, and a silicone heel grip helps keep the liner in place. Soft construction.

A 5.2-channel home theater receiver with 4K Ultra HD video support, including HDR and BT.2020 compatibility. Built-in Bluetooth and USB let you play music from many devices, and HEOS Link adds multi-room audio and streaming from popular music services.

specs.cable access: Holes for audio cables and mic stand

record.description: Portable vocal booth that places a foam-lined enclosure around a microphone to help reduce echo, reflections and room coloration for drier recordings. Folds flat for travel, works on a table or with common mic stands, and suits vocal recording, podcasting and voice-over work.

specs.material: 100% cotton washed canvas front, 100% polyester mesh back

record.description: Men's structured baseball-style cap from Carhartt in a musk green shade. The front is washed cotton canvas and the back is polyester mesh. A moisture-wicking sweatband and pre-curved sandwich visor add comfort, and a Carhartt patch sits on the front. One-size-fits-all design.

specs.operating system: Android TV with Google Assistant voice search
specs.audio: Internal bass-reflex speaker; 3.5mm stereo output with preset tone controls

record.description: A compact laser projector with built-in Android TV and a simple remote with voice search. It projects images up to 150 inches and includes an internal speaker plus a 3.5mm audio output. Its clean, modern housing is offered in black, with white-and-silver and black-and-copper versions also available.

specs.lining: Soft fabric lining with comfort footbed

record.description: A retro tennis-inspired women's sneaker with a leather upper and classic lacing for a secure fit. The rubber outsole has a herringbone pattern for traction, and the soft fabric lining with a comfort footbed supports all-day wear. The contrasting Swoosh runs from heel to midfoot.

specs.compartments: Double layer with 12 elastic cable loops and 6 elasticized mesh segments

record.description: A black travel organizer for cables, chargers, USB drives, and small electronics. Its water-resistant nylon shell has two zippers and two interior layers with elastic loops and mesh pockets. A tablet pocket and detachable hand strap make it easy to carry.

specs.water resistance: Highly water-resistant with UA Storm finish

record.description: A women's tote from Under Armour with a highly water-resistant UA Storm finish to handle the elements. It has a large main compartment, an oversized wordmark zipper pull, and double webbing straps for carrying several ways. Holds about 25 liters.

A modern take on a 1980s running style, this Nike shoe pairs a lightweight Flyknit upper with a snug, sock-like fit. Zoom Air cushioning supports each stride, and a heel pull tab makes it easy to put on. A durable rubber outsole completes the design.

specs.included: Magnetic screen, hook and loop roll, push pins, instruction manual

record.description: A magnetic door screen that lets fresh air and sunlight into your home while keeping insects out. Made from thickened fiberglass mesh with reinforced edges, double-stitched top center, and hook-and-loop fasteners to hold the screen in place in windy conditions. Fits standard doors about 36 by 80 inches.

specs.material: Shag pile with sponge middle layer
specs.use: Living room, bedroom, nursery, kids room

record.description: A large shaggy area rug in teal blue, designed for bedrooms, living rooms, and kids' rooms. Its long, soft pile feels plush underfoot, and a sponge middle layer adds some sound absorption. Small anti-slip dots on the underside help keep it in place on smooth floors. Keep the bottom dry to prevent slipping.

specs.fit: Regular fit, straight cut at waist
specs.care: Machine or hand wash cold; do not bleach

record.description: A long-sleeve popover henley with a mandarin collar and chest buttons, made from a cotton-polyester blend with a slightly thick oxford-style weave that resists see-through. Suited to late spring, cool summer days, and fall, and works for costume events or everyday wear.

specs.putting surface: approx. 2 ft x 8.5 ft inside border

record.description: A large practice putting mat with realistic turf designed to roll like a real green. It measures about 3 by 10 feet, with a putting area inside the border, and comes with two holes and flags. The padded rubber base suits indoor or outdoor use.

Manual-focus prime lens with a 35mm focal length and wide f/1.2 maximum aperture for APS-C mirrorless cameras with Canon EOS-M mount. Its large opening suits low-light shooting and shallow depth of field. Built with a metal body and a crescent-shaped focus ring for smooth manual control.

A pair of flameless LED pillar candles with a flickering moving-flame effect. The frosted plastic shells are water resistant for outdoor use and need no wax or wick trimming. A remote control adjusts brightness and flicker or steady modes and sets automatic on/off timers.

specs.included items: Long sleeve shirt or long johns (set)

record.description: Men's thermal base layer set with a long sleeve shirt or long johns, designed for cold-weather activity. Its stretchy, three-dimensional elastic zones allow free movement and support muscles. The fabric aims to keep you warm while wicking moisture and staying breathable. Suited to hiking, skiing, cycling and other outdoor training.

A replacement USB charging cable with a 2.0mm DC tip for the Mini S530 wireless Bluetooth earbuds. It has a 30cm cable and can charge from wall adapters, laptop USB ports, power banks, and car chargers. Check the tip dimensions before ordering, since some other headsets are not compatible.

specs.feature: Front pull tab for easy access
specs.decoration: Polyester felt dog appliqué on front

record.description: A fabric storage box for toddlers and kids that slides neatly into most cube shelving units. A front tab helps both children and adults pull it out easily, and a felt dog appliqué adds a playful touch.

specs.dimensions: 9.5 x 8.0 x 10.5 inches (expanded 11 x 8.0 x 10.5 inches)

record.description: A grey, insulated double-deck lunch bag with a leakproof PEVA liner that wipes clean easily. The two layers help keep foods separate, and the bag can hold snacks, drinks, and small daily items. Suitable for lunches, picnics, or as a casual tote for men and women.

A set of four stoneware rice bowls from Denby's Heritage Terrace line. Each piece is handcrafted by skilled artisans and suited to oven, microwave, freezer, and dishwasher use, making them practical for everyday meals and serving.

specs.infusion: Catnip infused between each corrugate layer
specs.use: Block for scratching, floor scratcher for crouching and lounging

record.description: A corrugate cardboard cat scratcher shaped as a chaise, offering a block for scratching and a cradle-style spot for lounging. Catnip is layered between the cardboard sheets so its scent is released as your cat scratches. Made in the USA, it gives cats a bark-like texture to scratch on the floor.
A sleeveless navy midi dress with a lace fabric and fit-and-flare silhouette. It is partially lined and has a contemporary cut that runs small, so check the size chart before ordering.
A cherry blossom scented body wash that gently cleanses the skin and leaves a delicate floral fragrance. Work it into wet skin, lather, and rinse for a fresh, perfumed shower.

specs.package_dimensions: 3.12 in L x 3.12 in W x 5.06 in H

record.description: Replacement oil filter for vehicle engines, sold under the WIX name. Model 57502XP. Packaged item weighs 0.75 pounds and measures about 3.12 by 3.12 by 5.06 inches. Made in China.

A large outdoor blanket made of nylon that resists sand and water and dries quickly. Four built-in pockets hold small valuables, and four stakes help anchor it in wind. It folds small for carrying and suits beaches, picnics, camping, and hiking, and can also serve as a yoga or baby play mat.
A versatile kids' boat shoe that works as a casual sneaker or a dress shoe. It has a leather-like upper, a lace-up closure for a snug fit, and a cushioned memory foam footbed for comfort.

A women's short fashion boot from UGG with a soft suede upper and a black finish. It features a UGGpure lining and insole for a plush feel, a Treadlite outsole, and a rubber UGG logo print on the front shaft.

specs.coverage: 12 in neck width, 22 in bottom width, 29 in height

record.description: A waterproof pink apron with a glossy, smooth surface that wipes clean easily. Ultra lightweight for long shifts, it suits cooking, food prep, gardening, garage work, and pet grooming. Adjustable matching straps and long waist ties provide a secure fit.

A full motion wall mount for flat and curved TVs and monitors from 13 to 30 inches, holding up to 33 pounds. It fits VESA patterns of 75x75mm and 100x100mm. Tilt, swivel, and rotation help set the viewing angle, and the steel arm extends up to 14 inches from the wall, then collapses close to it when not in use.

specs.dimensions: About 40 in height; shelf 11 in radius, 0.7 in thickness

record.description: A three-tier corner wall shelf made from lightweight paulownia wood with a torched dark brown finish. Hangs from a single nail, screw, or hook, and the jute rope lets you level the shelves. Works in living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms for displaying small décor, photos, or plants.
Soft cotton dresses for baby girls, sold as a coordinating set. The blueberry print suits everyday wear, and the fabric is gentle against delicate skin. Sized for 12 to 18 months.

Training pads for dogs of all sizes, measuring 22 by 23 inches. The rapid-drying top layer helps prevent tracking, and a gel layer traps liquid. A built-in attractant draws dogs to the pad to support potty training. Febreze freshness is included to help neutralize strong ammonia odors.

specs.material: ABS plastic mount, stainless steel rod
specs.included hardware: Mounting template, 2 drywall anchors, 2 masonry anchors, 2 wood screws

record.description: A collapsible wall-mounted drying rack that folds flat when not in use. It gives air-drying space for clothes in laundry rooms, closets, and bedrooms, and can be mounted on drywall, brick, concrete, or wood. Hanging clothes on it after drying can also help reduce wrinkles.

specs.lettering: Black 2 in x 12 in OVERSIZE LOAD

record.description: Mesh nylon banner in bright yellow that displays OVERSIZE LOAD in black letters for hauling wide or large loads. Brass grommets allow it to be attached to the front or back of a vehicle. Commonly used on equipment, boats, and modular homes where states require load marking.

A set of 48 bright neon green floating golf balls for practicing swings in water, at a pool, or on a pond. The two-piece build with 432 dimples and a molded Surlyn cover suits water-based practice and fun. A carry bag keeps the set organized between sessions.

specs.connection: Universal faucet adapter with quick connect

record.description: A compact countertop dishwasher suited to apartments, offices, and small kitchens. It offers six wash programs, adjustable delay start, and an LED display showing remaining time. Includes a six place setting rack and silverware basket, with a faucet adapter for common kitchen faucets.

specs.product type: DIY cake pop maker toy kit
specs.included: bain-marie, decorating stands, baking and decorating gadgets, recipe booklet

record.description: A kids' kit for making cake pops at home without an oven. It includes a bain-marie, decorating stands, and other baking and decorating tools, plus a printed recipe booklet. Food ingredients are not included, and the set is recommended for children aged 6 and up.

specs.installation: Designed for self-installation in a few seconds

record.description: A swivel faucet aerator that rotates 720 degrees so water can reach every part of a sink without soaking the user. It offers three flow settings, from gentle to strong, and adds air to create a softer, non-splashing stream. Made of brass with a polished finish, it attaches to most round kitchen and bathroom faucets.

specs.midsole: Bounce with Boost in the heel
specs.recycled content: Upper contains a minimum of 50% recycled content

record.description: Men's golf shoes from adidas in grey, green, and black with a regular fit and lace closure. The mesh and synthetic upper uses Primegreen recycled materials, and the Bounce midsole with Boost in the heel adds cushioning.
A men's straw hat in a natural tone with an outback-style brim and a vented crown to keep air moving. Sized XL, it suits warm-weather days outdoors.

A two-piece set of clear apothecary jars for organizing bathroom vanity items such as cotton swabs, cotton balls, cotton rounds, and bath salts. The jars look like glass but are made of plastic, and each has a removable lid and a wide opening for easy access. Suitable for bathroom, kitchen, or living room use.

specs.material: Hybrid dual layer: rubberized interior, hardened external cover
specs.features: Shockproof, card holder slot, kickstand, swivel belt clip
specs.included: 1 hybrid case, 1 tempered glass screen protector

record.description: A protective case for the Samsung Galaxy On5 with a brushed metal texture and a two-layer design that cushions impacts and resists scratches. It includes a card slot, a kickstand for viewing videos, and a swivel belt clip. A tempered glass screen protector is also included. Phone not included.

specs.motor: 180 pro hair removal motor, generation II
specs.use areas: Upper and lower lips, cheeks, chin

record.description: A compact electric facial hair remover for women that uses a dual stainless steel blade system to trim fine and coarse hair on the face. Designed for home use and travel, it is gentle on sensitive skin and includes one spare replacement head.

A double-layer camping hammock sized for two adults, made from seamless 210T nylon with a different color on each face. It packs into an attached bag that can hang from a backpack. Includes two straps with adjustable loops and two carabiner clips for setup between trees. Rated for up to 880 lbs and certified by German TUV.

specs.neck fit: 10 in per bullet point; 12 in per description
specs.chest fit: 14 in per bullet point; 16 in per description
specs.back length: 12 in per bullet point; 14 in per description

record.description: A hooded reindeer costume for dogs, sized Medium, closing with Velcro at the neck and chest. Suited to Christmas or other winter-themed parties and dress-up occasions.

A height-adjustable standing desk with a 47 by 30 inch wooden top and a metal frame rated for up to 165 pounds. Dual motors raise and lower it, and a tilt feature angles the desktop. An LED touch panel offers memory presets, a child lock, and two USB charging ports.

A ten-piece set of pirate-themed toy figures for imaginative play, including five pirates, a two-piece cannon, a treasure chest, an eye patch, and an X-marks-the-spot flag. Suited to school projects, dioramas, party favors, and cake decorations.

specs.cushioning: Gel pads in heel and forefoot

record.description: Trim-to-fit orthotic insole for men's casual and athletic shoes, sized for men's 9 to 10.5. Its contoured neutral arch suits most foot types, and lightweight gel pads in the heel and forefoot add comfort without bulk. A moisture-wicking treatment helps keep feet dry.

specs.material: Polyester fabric upholstery, walnut-stained wood legs
specs.style: Mid-century modern accent arm lounge chair

record.description: A mid-century accent chair with a curved back, cut-out silhouette, and gentle recline. Its polyester upholstery features piped trim, and dense foam padding gives the seat a soft, supportive feel. Dark walnut-stained legs have non-marking caps. Suits living rooms, bedrooms, offices, and entryways.

specs.features: BPA free, vacuum tight seal, locked clips

record.description: A two-tier round lunch container with a stainless steel build and white accents. Its twist-open lid and vacuum-tight seal help keep food from leaking or spilling, while locking clips hold both tiers together. Suitable for soup and hot food, and safe for dishwasher and freezer use.

specs.fit: Relaxed fit with comfort elastic waistband

record.description: Women's knit Bermuda pajama shorts in a chambray blue printed pattern. Features a comfortable elastic waistband and relaxed fit for lounging and sleep. Size Large with a 10.5-inch inseam.

specs.wings: Detachable wing gears, pair of holographic wings

record.description: Collectible 6-inch Falcon figure from Marvel's Avengers: Infinity War. Fully articulated, it can be switched into a flying pose using detachable wing gears. Extra hands, an optional head, a backpack for the wings, holographic wings, and two weapons are included, plus joint parts for use with a Tamashii Stage.

A red decorative sticker for the radiator grille of a 2018 Kia Stinger. It is 3D printed for a close fit and attaches with adhesive double-sided tape, requiring no tools for installation. Sold as one set.

A stylized vinyl collectible figure of Thor from the Avengers: Endgame film, made by Funko in its POP line. Standing about 3 and three-quarter inches tall, it suits display alongside other figures from the same series.

specs.theme: My Hero Academia / Boku No Hero Academia
specs.fit: Standard US size, for adults and kids

record.description: Anime-inspired training sweatpants featuring characters from My Hero Academia. Made from soft cotton, these long pants suit cosplay, Halloween, themed parties, or everyday wear. Listed as a standard US size fitting adults and kids. A playful gift option for anime fans.

A 9-foot round patio umbrella in beige that shades a table of four to six people. Its polyester canopy is described as water-resistant and fade-resistant, with a crank for raising and lowering and a push-button tilt to follow the sun. A vent at the top helps air move through the canopy. The base is not included.

specs.included items: Tin planter, plant liner, 2 coconut pucks, brush, paint strip, 3 seed packets

record.description: A hands-on kit for kids to grow their own flowers. Decorate a tin planter with paints that can be mixed into new shades, then plant Zinnia, Marigold, and Cosmo seeds and learn what helps them grow. Stake markers help keep each flower organized.

Men's hiking shoe with a suede leather and mesh upper for breathability on the trail. A bellows tongue with closed-cell foam helps keep moisture and debris out, while a rubber toe cap adds protection. Built on a Vibram TC5-plus sole with 5mm lugs for grip.

A lightweight hardside carry-on suitcase with a navy ABS shell and four multi-directional spinner wheels for smooth rolling. Features reinforced corners, a fully lined interior with zippered organizer pockets, and a garment restraint panel. Grab handles on the top, bottom, and sides aid lifting, and the telescoping trolley handle retracts when not in use.

specs.care: Hand wash cold, do not bleach, hang or line dry

record.description: A lightweight open front blazer with a draped silhouette, suited to office, casual, and evening wear. Its soft, slightly stretchy fabric and slip-on design make it an easy all-season layer. Hand wash cold and hang or line dry.

Building set for children that twists together into forts, tents, castles and tunnels. Rods lock into colored connector balls to form structures that stay put. Includes 120 pieces and a storage bag for indoor or outdoor play. Blankets are not included. Designed to encourage teamwork and imaginative play.

specs.material: Memory foam with silica gel top layer
specs.battery life: About 3-4 hours on high, 5-6 hours on low
specs.care: Washable

record.description: Rechargeable heated insoles with memory foam cushioning and arch support for keeping feet warm in cold weather. Three adjustable heat levels and a battery indicator let you manage power. Heating zones can be trimmed from the front to fit different shoe sizes, and the insoles are described as washable.

Women's aviator sunglasses from Jessica Simpson with a lightweight metal frame in a gold tone and gradient brown-tinted lenses. The polycarbonate lenses carry a UV-protective coating, and adjustable nose pads help with fit. A soft microfiber pouch is included for storage and cleaning.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Compression pants for men designed for football, soccer, running, yoga, and other sports in any weather. The soft stretch fabric is lightweight and aims to stay cool in summer and warm in winter. Compression fit is meant to support muscles and circulation. Sizing runs tight, so choose a larger size for a looser feel.
A heavyweight men's car coat in a black wool blend with a thick twill weave and soft, cozy hand. It has a button-front closure and a roomy cut through the chest and waist for layering.
A pack of twelve large decorative gift bows in silver metallic foil. Each bow measures about 4.5 inches across and has a self-adhesive backing for easy application to gift wrap and packages.

A compact Bluetooth FM transmitter that plugs into a car's power outlet. It streams music from a phone or tablet, plays files from a USB drive or TF card, and handles hands-free calls with one press. It has two USB charging ports, one with QC 3.0 fast charging, plus a lit display and colorful ambient lighting.

specs.feature: Inverted bottle keeps jelly fresh, clean and dry
specs.compatibility: Bottle interchangeable with most standard 32 oz. jelly jars

record.description: A red oriole feeder that holds 32 ounces of jelly in an inverted bottle design. An inner stirrer dispenses measured portions, and the bottle is simple to clean. Its bottle fits most standard 32-ounce jelly jars.

specs.care: Machine wash warm, gentle cycle, non-chlorine bleach

record.description: A king-size bedding set from Sferra's Grande Hotel Collection, made in Italy from 100% Egyptian cotton percale. The crisp white sheets are finished with double rows of colored satin stitching on the flat sheet, while the fitted sheet has none. Includes a flat sheet, a fitted sheet, and two pillowcases.

Ten white festoon LED bulbs for replacing car interior lights such as dome, map, and trunk or cargo area lamps. Each bulb carries 16 small 3528 surface-mount LEDs. The bulbs plug in directly, and if one does not light, rotating it 180 degrees fixes the polarity.
A gray marine boat seat designed to mount on most boat pedestals. It measures 18 by 21 by 6 inches and weighs about 8 pounds. Rated to support up to 400 pounds, and backed by a 3-year warranty.

specs.formula: Ammonia free, paraben free, gluten free, vegan

record.description: A deep, cool fuchsia semi-permanent hair color that is ready to use without developer. It sits on the hair shaft rather than penetrating it, so it fades gradually. The vegan, ammonia-free cream can also be mixed with other MANIC PANIC shades to create custom tones.

A mid-height ankle boot for women from Timberland's White Ledge line, built for hiking and outdoor wear. It features shock-absorbing cushioning and a rubber lug outsole for traction on varied terrain.

A low-profile Under Armour cap with a pre-curved visor and structured front panels that hold their shape. Foam padding behind the front panel adds comfort, and Microthread fabric is designed to dry quickly and stay off the skin.
A compact 0.7 cubic foot microwave oven in red from Daewoo, model KOR07R3ZER. It comes with a turntable for more even heating of food and fits well on a counter or in a small kitchen.

specs.suitable_for: Bridal, bridesmaids, flower girls, festivals, photography

record.description: A handmade flower crown headband in royal blue, designed to wear as a hair wreath at weddings, festivals, and photo sessions. Its roughly 19 cm diameter suits most head sizes, and its floral design gives a charming, eye-catching look for brides, bridesmaids, and young flower girls.

specs.design: Z-shaped legs with built-in metal frame
specs.features: Cup holder, headphone hook, cable management tray, two speaker/CD holders

record.description: A gaming desk with a curved, carbon-fiber-style work surface large enough for a computer, keyboard, and books. Built-in cup holder, headphone hook, and cable tray help keep the setup organized. Z-shaped metal frame and suction feet aim to keep it steady on the floor.

A professional-style curling iron with an extra-long barrel for longer hair, a rotating cool tip, and a rheostat dial for adjusting heat up to 430 degrees. A heat-resistant mat is included to protect your counter while the iron cools.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Mad Grip impact gloves with a breathable knit body and grip injection coating for handling. Reinforced in high-abrasion areas to aid durability and vibration dampening. Machine washable and offered in large in high-visibility orange, suited to both large and small parts.

specs.suspension: Front telescopic forks, rear mono shock

record.description: A 50cc two-stroke, air-cooled kids' dirt bike with a pull-start engine and an automatic twist throttle, built for young off-road riders. Features include front telescopic forks, rear shock suspension, and disc brakes. Suitable for wet and dry outdoor terrain.

specs.cable: Not included; use original iPhone cable

record.description: A black battery case for iPhone 6, 6s, 7 and 8 with a 6000 mAh lithium-polymer battery. It can charge the phone on demand via a power button and supports earphones and wireless Bluetooth accessories. It is charged with your own Apple cable, and it does not protect the screen.

specs.construction: 3-layer hybrid: hard polycarbonate shell with soft clear TPU interior
specs.design: Full body protection with raised bezel for screen and camera
specs.cutouts: Large cut-outs for buttons, ports and camera

record.description: A rose gold glitter case for the Apple iPhone XR, combining a firm outer shell with a soft clear inner layer for full-body coverage. Raised edges help guard the screen and camera lens, while large cutouts keep buttons, ports and speakers accessible.

specs.extras: Detachable leather wrist strap, foldable kickstand

record.description: A wallet-style protective case for the Samsung Galaxy S20 5G. It holds cards, cash and a coin pocket, and folds into a kickstand for hands-free viewing. A magnetic flip closure keeps contents secure, and a detachable wrist strap helps with carrying.

specs.type: Leaf net cover for swimming pools
specs.securing: Tuck under water tubes or use reinforced tie-down loops

record.description: A rectangular leaf net that lays over a winter pool cover to catch falling leaves before they decay on the cover or in the water. Made from knitted polyethylene, it lifts off easily once trees are bare. Tuck it under water tubes or fasten it with the reinforced tie-down loops.

Replacement caster wheels for office chairs, sold as a set of five. The blue polyurethane wheels roll quietly over cables and are meant for hardwood, carpet, laminate, tile and similar floors, so a chair mat is not needed. The standard 7/16 inch stem fits common chair bases.

specs.included: Generic MFi certified charger and charging cable

record.description: A refurbished Apple iPhone 8 with 64GB storage in Space Gray, locked to AT&T and not compatible with other carriers. Battery health was tested. Headphones and SIM card are not included.
A roomy, wide-brimmed costume bonnet that adds a patriotic, Americana flair to a themed outfit. Designed to fit most teens and adults, it comes in white and two other color choices.

specs.included_accessories: Walking foot, non-stick foot, clearance plate, 5-pack size 16 needles

record.description: A heavy-duty sewing machine from SINGER with 32 built-in stitches, including buttonholes, decorative and stretch options. It features a metal frame, a built-in needle threader, and a reported top speed of 1,100 stitches per minute. Heavy-duty accessories such as a walking foot and non-stick foot are included for thick fabrics and leather.
Men's green Chewbacca-themed socks in size large, featuring a seamless toe closure, arch support, and reinforced heel and toe areas.

specs.item: Color changing gel nail polish set
specs.wear time: Up to 2+ weeks with proper application

record.description: A six-color set of temperature-changing gel nail polish from Modelones, each 7 ml bottle shifting shade with nail temperature. Designed for salon-style manicures at home, it cures under an LED lamp and needs a base and top coat. Packaged in a gift box for holidays and birthdays.

specs.material: Poly blend webbing with PVC coated S hooks
specs.included: 4 ratchet buckles, 4 hook straps, 4 loop straps, mesh bag

record.description: A four-piece set of red ratchet tie-down straps for securing cargo such as canoes, kayaks, motorcycles, bikes, and boats. Each strap is ten feet long and one inch wide, with a 900 lb break strength. PVC-coated hooks help protect surfaces from scratches, and a mesh bag keeps the set organized for storage.

A set of three double-walled glass espresso cups holding 5 ounces each. The insulated design helps keep hot drinks warm and cold drinks cool. Suited to espresso, cappuccino, macchiato, and tea, and a simple gift for friends and family.

specs.material: Liquid silicone gel rubber with microfiber lining
specs.features: Raised 1mm bezel, supports wireless charging

record.description: A slim protective case for the iPhone X and iPhone XS, made of soft liquid silicone with a microfiber inner lining. It covers the back, sides and raised edges around the screen and camera, and it lets wireless charging pass through without removing the case. The surface resists fingerprints and wipes clean with a damp cloth.

A neoprene sleeve that keeps a water bottle or long neck bottle cold. Its drawstring top holds bottles of several sizes, and it comes with a strap for carrying and a clip for attaching it to a belt or backpack. Suited to cycling, hiking, travel, and other outdoor sports.

A set of 100 one-milliliter plastic syringes, each sealed separately and fitted with a cap to keep the tip clean and prevent leaks. The clear markings help measure and dispense small liquid amounts for oils, inks, perfumes, lab work, garden watering, or pet medication.

A slim protective case for iPhone 7, iPhone 8, and iPhone SE 2020 with a marble pattern. The flexible TPU shell is paired with a 360-degree rotating ring that props the phone up for watching videos. Raised edges shield the camera, and cutouts keep ports, buttons, and speaker accessible.

specs.material: MDF with wood grain finish, metal frame legs
specs.assembly: About 20 minutes, tools and instructions included

record.description: A large rustic office desk with a wide wood-grain top for monitors, laptops, and writing supplies. Its metal X-shaped legs, support mesh and adjustable feet aim to keep it steady. Suits home offices, lofts, and farmhouse-style spaces. Assembly is quick.

specs.finish: Brushed matte outer surface, high polish inner face

record.description: A men's tungsten carbide wedding band with a brushed matte outer surface and a polished inner face. Its black and silver tones carry a rose gold accent line. The comfort fit is durable and scratch resistant. Ships with a storage box and comes with a lifetime warranty.

A large 8.5-inch Moen showerhead offering a full rainshower spray, a concentrated rinse, and a combination spray setting. Its reflective chrome finish suits a range of bathroom styles. Self-pressurizing rainshower technology is intended to deliver strong water coverage.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low
specs.type: Dual-function pocket mitt and pot holder

record.description: A pair of pocket-style kitchen mitts made from absorbent cotton terry cloth. The pockets help shield your hands when lifting hot cookware, and the flat design doubles as a pot holder to protect countertops from hot dishes. Machine washable in cold water.

specs.material: Breathable elastic fabric with medical-grade gel separator
specs.fit: Elastic loop around the heel to prevent slipping off
specs.type: Non-surgical bunion splint and toe separator

record.description: A beige non-surgical splint intended to hold the big toe in a straighter position and help ease bunion discomfort. Its breathable elastic fabric wraps the foot, and a gel separator sits between the toes. An elastic loop around the heel helps it stay in place overnight, and it fits most US shoe sizes 6 to 11.

specs.part type: Front bumper license plate mounting bracket

record.description: A front bumper bracket for holding a license plate on select Ford F-150 and Lincoln Mark LT trucks from 2006 to 2008. Made from black automotive-grade thermoplastic, it comes with the screws needed for installation.

specs.key ingredients: Vitamin C, witch hazel, MSM, vitamin E, glycolic acid

record.description: A facial toner in a fine-mist spray, built around vitamin C and witch hazel. Intended to help prep skin for serums and moisturizers, and aimed at sensitive, dry, and combination complexions. Comes in a 4 oz bottle.

specs.under-desk clearance: 27 inches from metal frame to floor
specs.included: iron hook and free CPU stand

record.description: A large L-shaped corner desk with a vintage wood look, suited to home offices, gaming setups, and dorm rooms. The thick desktop can hold several monitors, and an X-shaped crossbar with adjustable leg pads helps it stay steady on uneven floors. Open space beneath fits legs or a computer tower. An iron hook and CPU stand are included.

specs.features: Multifunctional SIM tool and bottle opener

record.description: A slim, lightweight key organizer that holds up to 20 keys in one compact unit, keeping them tidy and quiet in a pocket, purse, or running belt. Built from carbon fiber for sturdiness, it also includes a SIM tool and bottle opener. Assembly guidance is provided through video instructions.
A small carbon-lined pouch with an airtight design meant to keep odors contained. Measures about 11 by 6 inches, fits in a backpack or carried by hand. Features a velcro closure and a wrist strap.

specs.care: machine wash cold on gentle cycle; hang or flat dry

record.description: A twin-size weighted blanket that rests on top of the mattress to give a gentle, even pressure. Filled with glass beads and sewn in seven layers to help keep the fill inside. Made of 100% cotton and rated at 12 lbs. Wash cold on a gentle cycle and dry flat or hang to dry.

specs.material: 3mm sequins on one side, satin on the other

record.description: Two baby blue pillow covers with a shimmering sequin face and a soft satin back, sized for 18-inch inserts. Suited to weddings, holidays, and everyday decor, these covers can dress up a bed, sofa, or chair. Dry wash or hand wash carefully, then hang to dry.

A sparkly cubic zirconia ring set with a pear-shaped teardrop design, suited to bridal, bridesmaid, and engagement wear. It pairs with classic casual or formal outfits. Ships with a gift box and favor bag, making it a thoughtful present.

specs.features: Oven safe, dishwasher safe

record.description: A rectangular stainless steel rack for cooling and baking. Its grid pattern supports small items such as cookies while letting air circulate. The sturdy build is meant to resist warping, and the rack can be washed in a dishwasher.
A one-ounce bottle of black pigmented ink for tattoo work. It is made in the USA and is intended for use across many tattoo styles, with a formula meant to heal clear and vivid on the skin.

specs.length: Adjustable, approx. 43-49 inches including snap hooks

record.description: Replacement adjustable shoulder strap for handbags and purses, made from soft brown synthetic leather with metal hardware. Adjusts from about 43 to 49 inches including snap hooks and features a 0.7-inch double-layer band. Suited to replacing a worn cross-body strap on a bag.

specs.habit forming: No (non-habit forming when used as directed)
specs.claimed effect: Helps fall asleep about 33% faster than placebo in a clinical study

record.description: Nighttime sleep aid in tablet form containing doxylamine succinate. Each dose is a single tablet, and the 80-count bottle is packaged for repeated nightly use. Intended to help you fall asleep and stay asleep through the night, the maker describes it as non-habit forming and free of grogginess or lingering side effects the next day.

A set of six stemless champagne flutes made from clear Tritan plastic, designed to look like glass while resisting breakage. Each flute holds 12 oz and suits prosecco, mimosas, and celebrations. The BPA-free plastic is dishwasher safe and reusable for parties and everyday use.

specs.package: 1 afro puff with headwrap, 1 eyelash, 1 hairpin

record.description: A curly, short-length synthetic wig with an attached elastic headband for quick wear. Its wavy afro-puff style suits everyday, work, travel, and party looks. Tie back your natural hair, slip the headband on, and tighten the drawstring to secure it. The maker advises washing rarely, avoiding hair dryers, and using a wide-tooth comb.

A 100-inch projection screen with a wrinkle-free matte PVC surface for home, office, school, or outdoor viewing. Its bottom-roll design sets up without screws, and the tripod stand adjusts in height and folds into the included carry bag for storage.

A 10-inch French whip for mixing batters, sauces, and other kitchen preparations in bowls or saucepans. Made in the USA from 18/8 stainless steel wires, it is NSF approved and can be cleaned in the dishwasher.

specs.removal: Removable with no damage or residue

record.description: A blue vinyl decal sticker featuring a lion head design with a 'Born to be a King' theme. The removable decal measures about 3.7 by 5 inches and comes with installation instructions.

specs.included_items: Keia figure, bouncy chair, brush, food and water bowls, flower shower, bridge

record.description: A two-story playset based on the Puppy Dog Pals preschool show, featuring the neighborhood pup Keia's treehouse. Kids can work the elevator, bounce the chair, spin the lookout, and use the flower shower with the included 3-inch poseable figure. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

Binder pages for storing CDs and DVDs in a standard 3-ring binder. Each sheet holds four discs, with a soft non-woven liner that helps guard media against scratches, fingerprints, and smudges. A 25-pack provides room for up to 100 discs.

A commercial-style drip coffee brewer from Bunn, model AXIOM-15-3, built to run on a standard 120V, 60Hz, single-phase outlet. It ships as one unit and is made in the United States, suited to brewing coffee in busy kitchens and workplaces.

specs.closure: YKK zipper with double metal button
specs.pockets: 2 waterproof zipper pockets, 2 hook and loop flap pockets

record.description: Men's insulated snow pants for skiing and snowboarding. The water-repellent, windproof shell has taped seams, and the quilted insulation is meant to keep the wearer warm. Two zippered pockets and two flap pockets hold small essentials, and gaiters with grippers help keep snow out of the boots.

specs.packaging: Individual box with photo on front

record.description: A miniature sloth figurine hanging from a tree branch, part of the Jim Shore Heartwood Creek collection. Hand-crafted from stone resin and hand-painted, it reflects folk-art inspired styling with traditional quilt patterns and decorative motifs.

Wired craft ribbon with a woven fall plaid pattern in warm orange and green, with metallic accents. The monofilament wire along the edges helps loops and bows keep their shape. Suited to fall and Thanksgiving decor, floral arrangements, wreaths, and gift wrapping.

specs.closure: Button down front, cuffs, and collar

Men's slip-on driving loafer from Lacoste in black leather. Features a flexible moccasin construction and an embossed crocodile logo. A cushioned foam insole adds comfort and shock absorption for everyday wear.

specs.details: Ribbing at collar, cuffs and hem

record.description: A lightweight long-sleeve crewneck sweater for women in a classic, close-but-comfortable fit that allows easy movement. Soft yarn and ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem give it a neat finish for everyday wear.

Organized interior with a laptop sleeve, mesh pockets, and a hidden anti-theft back pocket for valuables.

Opaque acrylic paint in a deep mars black shade from Sargent Art. The paint blends smoothly and dries to a waterproof finish. Packaged in a 75 mL tube with a peggable cap, and labeled as non-toxic under ASTM D 4236.

A long, striped Santa hat for the holiday season, with red and white stripes, faux fur trim, and a pom-pom on top. Made from soft felt and faux fur, it is designed to be comfortable for teens and adults to wear.

A two-pack of men's short sleeve T-shirts in white, extra large. Each shirt has a left chest pocket with a small exterior logo, a tagless back neck label, and taped neck and shoulder seams for longer wear.

A classic European-style vanity stool with a padded seat and carved solid wood legs. Its MDF frame and wood legs aim for stability, and the high-density sponge seat is covered in polyester fabric. Use it at a dressing table, or as a dining, lounge, or piano stool.

A navy kitchen island with a solid wood butcher block top suited to food prep or extra serving space. Two smooth-glide drawers and three cabinets offer storage. Includes both casters for mobility and feet for a stationary setup, with brushed nickel hardware.

specs.safety: ASTM D-4236 & EN71 conforming, non-toxic, acid-free

Men's Superstar sneakers from Golden Goose with a grey suede-look upper and smooth blue leather star and heel tab. The cushioned rubber sole and lightweight build aim for everyday comfort. A versatile casual design with a vintage-inspired finish.

Men's slip-on sneaker from Quiksilver with a mesh upper assembled without stitching. Molded structural underlays are welded in place to support a performance-oriented fit. Offered in a grey and white colorway.

A machine-woven area rug with a modern Moroccan-inspired ombre pattern. Its synthetic fibers resist stains and the low pile sheds very little. Women's slide sandal from Ted Baker in the Avelini style, in a yellow colorway. Listed in US size 8.5 Regular. The listing gives no further details on materials or construction, so check the product page before purchasing.

A decorative throw pillow for campers who enjoy good company around the fire. It features a humorous campfire design with white lettering and prints on both sides. Filled with polyester and sewn closed, it is a fun novelty gift for camping couples and beer lovers.

specs.style: Linear wordmark knit on outside of foot

Black ballet flats with a soft faux-suede upper, elastic ankle straps, and a rear zipper for easy on-and-off wear. Round-toe, slip-on design suits casual, work, and semi-formal outfits. Lightweight with a cushioned sole for everyday walking.

specs.frame: Pine wood bar, ready to hang

specs.cup detail: Sheer mesh window at top of cups

Individual eyelash extensions in a hybrid silk mink blend, offered in several L-series curls and thicknesses for custom lash application. Lashes are designed to lift cleanly from the strip with minimal residue or kinking. Available in mixed or single lengths from 8 to 15mm.

A lightweight baby lounger for indoor or outdoor use that converts into a backpack in one motion. It includes a detachable activity bar and canopy, a waterproof base, and a machine-washable cover. Its natural finish suits a range of settings.

Vetiver incense sticks rolled in Vietnam, with a light, earthy, woodsy scent. Each pack holds 68 sticks, 11 inches long, totaling 200 grams. Made from a blend of herbs, resins, woods and oils, they suit worship, meditation, yoga, or simply scenting a room.

Women's Rolex Datejust reference 179178 with an 18k yellow gold bracelet and bezel and a silver dial. Listed in excellent condition, with service performed as needed, a final quality check before shipment, and a one-year warranty from the seller.

Six pairs of women's crew socks with assorted patterns and colors, made from a cotton, spandex, and polyester blend. The combed cotton is meant to feel soft and help manage moisture and odor. Suitable for US women's sizes 5 to 9, they work for both athletic and everyday wear.

A beige 9-foot patio umbrella with a push-button tilt and crank lift for adjusting shade over tables or seating. Its five rectangular metal ribs support a polyester canopy, and a top vent helps air flow. Base stand sold separately.

Four glass-jar candles in a Mulled Cider scent, each with three wicks and 11.5 ounces of wax. Designed to fill a room with warm, spiced fragrance for gatherings or everyday relaxation. Store in a cool place for best results.
