record.description: A three-bike carrier that attaches to a vehicle's trunk and holds bicycles with individual tie-downs. Its padded lower frame guards the vehicle's surface, and side straps add stability. It arrives assembled and folds flat when not in use.

A floor-length maxi dress in deep burgundy with an off-the-shoulder neckline, layered ruffles, and an empire waist. It has a side thigh-high slit and elastic at the back for comfort. Can be worn off the shoulder, with straps, one shoulder, or strapless.

A men's quartz wristwatch with a round wooden case and stainless steel bracelet band. Personalized engraving on the back makes it a customizable gift for birthdays, holidays, and milestones. Lightweight and comfortable to wear, with a Japanese quartz movement and a bamboo watch box included.

A 14-inch wall clock from Bulova inspired by Frank Lloyd Wright's Luxfer Prism design. It features two prism patterns, raised hour markers, and shadowed graphics on a cream dial, with bronze rods framing the face. A quartz movement keeps time.

specs.rear camera: 13 MP main with PDAF; 5 MP 120° super wide

record.description: An unlocked LG smartphone in silver with 32 GB of storage. It has a 5.7-inch HD+ display, a 13 MP main rear camera with fast autofocus, and a 5 MP super wide rear camera. The 5 MP front camera offers portrait mode, and the 3,000 mAh battery is rated for long use.

A double-sided makeup mirror with a regular side and a 10X magnified side for close detail work. The 5.8-inch glass surface gives a wide, clear view. It rotates 360 degrees and locks at any angle, and its lightweight frame suits both tabletop placement and handheld use.

specs.product type: Accessory bundle for Cricut Joy machine
specs.included items: Tote, 3-pc tool set, 3 fine-point pens, replacement blade, digital guide
specs.digital guide: Cricut Smart Materials eBook, emailed (no paper copy)
specs.compatibility: Cricut Joy machine; blade needs Blade Housing (sold separately)

record.description: A starter kit for Cricut Joy machine owners that bundles a padded carrying tote, a three-piece weeding, spatula and scraper tool set, and fine-point pens in green, red and violet. It also includes a replacement blade and an emailed digital guide to Cricut smart materials for beginners.

A dainty evil eye pendant necklace with a hammered finish and cubic zirconia accent, finished in gold plating over brass. Its extension chain adds length options, and the piece suits parties, weddings, or graduations. Lead and nickel free, and it arrives in a gift box.

A hand-carved salt lamp made from pink Himalayan rock salt, mounted on a natural neem wood base. Each lamp has a distinctive shape. The integrated dimmer adjusts the warm orange glow for day or night use. Arrives fully assembled in a gift box.

A stovetop espresso maker in the Milano style, brewing rich, dense coffee in the Italian moka tradition. Its anodized aluminum body holds enough for six espresso-sized cups. Works on gas and electric stoves, but not induction cooktops. Hand washing is recommended.

Men's sneaker from adidas Originals with a knit upper and mesh lining. Features a speed lacing system, webbing tape with 3 Stripes detailing, and a nubuck heel. An OrthoLite sockliner is included for added comfort.

Unisex stud earrings with a magnetic clasp instead of a traditional pin, so they can be worn with or without a piercing. Made of stainless steel with square cubic zirconia stones in white and black. Sold as a two-pair set.

specs.care: Machine wash

record.description: Relaxed-fit knit Bermuda shorts with a longer length for everyday wear. Made from a soft cotton and polyester blend, they feature an elasticized waistband, side pockets, and a pull-on design. Machine washable.

A 10-inch silicone-coated whisk for blending, whisking, beating, stirring, cooking, and baking. The non-stick coating is meant to protect cookware, and the stainless steel handle has a non-slip grip and a hanging hole for storage. Designed to be easy to clean.

specs.compartments: 1 bill section, 1 kiss lock coin pocket

record.description: A tri-fold women's wallet in soft synthetic leather with a snap closure. It offers 13 card slots, two clear photo slots, a bill section, and a kiss-lock coin pocket. Decorated with stitching and a small cat hanging below a bowknot, it suits everyday use or as a gift for teen girls.

A tufted storage bench offering extra seating and hidden storage for a sitting room, entryway, or bedroom. It has a hardwood frame and bonded-leather upholstery, with crystal-like accents and a padded top that works as a seat or footrest.

specs.use: indoor and outdoor on smooth surfaces; not for fabric

record.description: Permanent adhesive vinyl sheet set from Ohuhu with 60 twelve-inch square sheets in 30 shades, plus 10 clear transfer tape sheets for moving designs onto surfaces. Suited to craft cutters and decorating projects such as walls, mugs, and tumblers. Sheets are described as weather resistant for indoor and outdoor use on smooth surfaces, but not suitable for fabric.

Slim one-piece protective case made for the Apple iPhone X only. Its synthetic rubber interior absorbs shock, while the polycarbonate outer shell helps prevent scratches and a raised edge helps shield the touchscreen. This certified refurbished unit has been tested, cleaned, and comes with a minimum 90-day warranty.

A women's full-zip fleece jacket from Columbia's Benton Springs line, made from soft polyester fleece for warmth. It has a collared neck and two side zippered pockets for keeping small items secure, with a classic, active cut suited to cold days and outdoor activity.

A sonic electric toothbrush for adults with five modes and three intensity levels. It features an 8mm swing amplitude and a built-in two-minute smart timer that pauses every 30 seconds as a reminder to move to another area. Its W-shaped medium-soft bristles are designed to follow tooth contours. It charges over USB and includes a protective bristle cover for travel.

specs.item: Giant Hairgrass (Eleocharis vivipara) live aquarium plants

record.description: A six-bunch package of live Giant Hairgrass for freshwater aquariums. This aquatic plant has a sturdy root system that draws nutrients from substrate and works well as a background cover for tanks. Its growth helps add oxygen and absorb carbon dioxide, providing shelter for fish.

A cozy wearable blanket for big kids that replaces loose bedding. The sack-style design leaves room to move and is built so it stays on through the night. Foot openings let kids walk around when awake, and there is room to tuck feet in at bedtime.

A cotton pajama set with a crewneck top and relaxed-fit bottoms featuring a no-fly string waist. Bottoms in plaid or lumberjack prints are flannel with side pockets, while others are jersey. Designed with a Star Trek TNG print for lounging or sleep.

Men's leather lace-up shoe from Timberland with a handsewn upper stitched to the midsole and cemented to a rubber lug outsole. Features rawhide lacing for a custom fit, a leather lining and footbed, and an EVA insert with Poron foam under the forefoot for cushioning.

specs.seat dimensions: 23.50 in deep x 45.00 in wide x 17.75 in high
specs.features: Deep button tufting, nail head accents, scrolled arms, turned legs

record.description: A traditional Chesterfield loveseat with deep button tufting, nail head trim on the scrolled arms, and turned legs. Two-tone navy blue and dark brown finish. Individually applied nail heads add a handcrafted touch to this classic seat for two.

specs.included: 2 outer plates, 1 inner plate, exhaust adaptor, tape, 4 screws

record.description: Adjustable window vent kit for portable air conditioners with a 5.9-inch exhaust hose. Plates slot together and slide to fit different window widths, and extra plates can be left out when not needed. Check your unit's exhaust outlet diameter before buying, since the hose cut-out must measure about 5.9 inches inner edge to inner edge.

A unisex crewneck sweatshirt in maroon featuring a white screen-printed Hawkins Middle School AV Club design. Made with a 50/50 blend for a soft feel. Sizing typically runs large for women, so consider ordering accordingly.

specs.handle: 5/8 inch diameter marine grade 12 strand nylon rope

record.description: A 3.5 gallon underwater viewing bucket with a clear acrylic lens and a 9-inch viewing area, built for small boats, kayaks, paddle boards and shore use. The thick rope handle is easy to grip and carry, and stainless steel hooks let you stack buckets. A lens protector lets you fill the bucket without scratching the lens.

A cordless, hoseless pool vacuum for inground and above ground pools, including soft-sided models. It runs on a rechargeable lithium ion battery for up to 45 minutes per charge and has push-button start. The removable head handles general cleaning and detaches for tight spots. It is lightweight and works by hand or on a standard telescopic pole.

specs.autofocus: 191-point AF system with Dual Pixel CMOS AF
specs.continuous shooting: up to 16 fps (20 fps in Live View)

record.description: A professional full-frame DSLR camera from Canon with a 20.1 megapixel sensor and DIGIC X processor. It offers a wide ISO range, 191-point autofocus with face and head tracking, and fast continuous shooting. The kit includes a CFexpress card and reader, and it records 4K video.

specs.finish: Unfinished wood with rustic white letters

record.description: A wooden wall sign spelling HOME across four square tiles, suited to kitchens, living rooms, and dining rooms. Its rustic white lettering and weathered wood look suit country and farmhouse decor. Hooks and string come pre-installed for easy hanging, and the tiles can also be hung separately.

A low-profile wall mount for flat-panel TVs and monitors sized 37 to 80 inches, rated for up to 130 pounds. Its fixed brackets hold the screen close to the wall, and lateral shift helps center it over off-center studs. An open wall plate leaves room for concealed cable routing.

specs.included: Tension rod, 22-inch short rod, 40-inch long rod, 2 rubber end caps, user manual

record.description: A spring-loaded tension rod that expands from 83 to 120 inches and fits inside a window or doorway without drilling. Its powder-coated steel finish resists rust. Suitable for hanging curtains, room dividers, or hangers in laundry areas.

A steel storage cabinet with four adjustable shelves for organizing documents, supplies, tools, and household goods. Black powder-coated metal frame resists corrosion. Includes four detachable rubber casters, two lockable, for easy movement without scratching floors. Built-in lock included. Assembly required with tools.

specs.care: Hand wash or machine washable

record.description: A long-sleeved grey bodysuit for newborns, made from a soft, stretchy cotton blend. The expandable neckline makes dressing easy, and snap closures help with diaper changes. Printed with playful lettering, it suits casual daily wear, sleepwear, or as a baby shower gift.

A limited-edition hardcover notebook from Moleskine with a Sakura-themed cover and a classic leather-look finish. It has 240 ruled pages on thick ivory paper suited to ballpoint, pencil, and fountain pen writing, plus an elastic closure band and inner storage folders for notes.

Soft first-walker sneakers for infants and toddlers, made with a breathable mesh upper to keep little feet cool and dry. Rubber soles with grip pods help prevent slipping as babies learn to balance, and a padded footbed adds comfort. A stretchy collar makes them quick to slip on and off.

specs.product type: Temporary hair color wax / styling cream mud
specs.key ingredients: Carnauba wax, beeswax, cetearyl alcohol, tea extract, licorice extract

record.description: A temporary hair color wax that doubles as a styling cream for shaping and texturing hair. It is designed for color changes for a party, costume, or event, and it washes out with warm water. Best applied to slightly damp hair, it is meant for occasional use rather than permanent color.

specs.included: 24W mini UV lamp, nano nail file, 2 toe separators, USB cable

record.description: A compact 120-watt UV LED nail lamp for curing gel polish at home. It offers four timer settings, an automatic sensor, and an LCD screen. A folding mini lamp and USB power make it easy to carry for quick touch-ups.

Hand mixer with seven speeds and a turbo boost for whipping, mixing, and kneading batters, dough, cream, and eggs. Comes with two beaters and two dough hooks that attach to the underside for storage. Compact white body with a non-slip grip; attachments are dishwasher-safe and the body wipes clean.

Full motion wall mount for flat-panel TVs and computer monitors from 13 to 40 inches. It tilts, swivels, and rotates between portrait and landscape orientations, and extends from 2 to 15 inches off the wall. Supports up to 33 pounds and fits VESA 75 and 100 patterns. Check your screen's back before purchase to confirm compatibility.

Four skeins of Alize Diva silk-effect yarn in cream, made from 100% microfiber acrylic. The fine fingering weight suits knitting and crochet projects, and the lightweight yarn has a soft, silky sheen suited to spring and summer garments.

specs.pattern: Watercolor cowboy riding horse and calf roping, printed on two sides
specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, no bleach, tumble dry low

record.description: A decorative throw pillow cover featuring a watercolor-style cowboy on horseback roping a calf, printed on both sides. Made from a cotton and linen blend with a hidden zipper for easy insertion. Sized at 18 by 18 inches; the pillow insert is sold separately. Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: A reversible sherpa throw in a bright patchwork of floral and geometric patterns, suited to cottage, bohemian, or modern decor. Its soft polyester surface makes it a cozy choice for a living room, the foot of a bed, or a nursery, and it also works as a gift. Machine washable in cold water.

A stick-on touch light with eight SMD LEDs and a swivel head that aims up or down. Touch the metal pins to switch it on, dim it, or turn it off. It recharges by micro-USB, remembers your last brightness, and mounts with adhesive tape in closets, under cabinets, and other dark spaces.

specs.care: Machine washable, cold water, gentle cycle; no bleach or iron

record.description: Square velvet throw pillow covers in a golden yellow striped pattern, sold as a two-pack. The removable covers have an invisible zipper and a soft finish for sofas, beds, and chairs. Pillow inserts are not included and must be bought separately. Machine washable on a gentle cycle in cold water.

Individually wrapped essential oil towelettes meant for cleaning hands on the go. Made as a gentler, natural option compared with alcohol-based wipes, and suited to travel, public restrooms, and everyday surfaces. Pack fits easily in a purse, backpack, or pocket.

A festive spruce wreath for the front door, decorated with pine cones and 50 battery-powered LED lights. A built-in timer switches the lights on for six hours and off for eighteen, so the display glows at night without manual control. Suitable for Christmas and other holiday seasons, indoors or outdoors.

A reversible collar that wraps around the base pole of an artificial Christmas tree to hide the fake-looking green fuzz underneath. One side shows a brown tree bark print, the other a candy pattern. It can be folded or trimmed to fit most poles.

specs.dimensions: 7.4 x 7.4 x 2.3 inches (L x H x W)
specs.pattern: Leopard snakeskin print on front pocket

record.description: A small round crossbody bag for women, made of soft PU leather with a black finish and gold-tone hardware. It can be carried as a shoulder bag or crossbody. The main compartment has a top zipper, and there are inside and outside pockets for everyday items.

A four-slice toaster with two independent control panels, so two people can toast different settings at once. Features six browning levels, reheat, defrost and bagel functions with LED indicators, wide slots, an extra-lift carriage lever and a slide-out crumb tray.

specs.compatibility: Select Chevrolet, GMC, and Isuzu models

record.description: Replacement front driver-side window regulator for select Chevrolet, GMC, and Isuzu vehicles. Designed to match the original equipment shape and dimensions, and tested through thousands of door cycles. Confirm fitment for your exact make, model, and trim before ordering.

specs.key ingredients: garlic, parsley, chlorophyll, aged black garlic extract

record.description: NutraChamps odorless garlic softgels deliver 1000mg of garlic in a flaxseed oil base, combined with parsley, chlorophyll, and aged black garlic extract. Marketed as a supplement for heart, blood pressure, cholesterol, and immune support.

specs.finish: Red lacquered body with brass-lacquered keys
specs.key features: High F# key, C#-Bb connected table key
specs.case: Light rectangular case with backpack straps
specs.included: Mouthpiece with ligature and cap, cleaning cloth, carrying strap

record.description: Student-level Eb alto saxophone from Roy Benson with a brass body finished in red lacquer and brass-lacquered keys. Features a high F# key and a connected C#-Bb table key, plus a hardened blue steel spring. Comes with a lightweight rectangular case with backpack straps, a mouthpiece with ligature and cap, a cleaning cloth, and a carrying strap.
Women's wrap-style dress with a surplice neckline and an abstract floral print in ivory and black. Short flutter sleeves add a feminine touch. Offered in size small.

Disposable black plastic straws sold in a dispenser box of 500. At just over seven inches long, they suit both soft and hard drinks. Made from food-safe, BPA-free polypropylene, they work for bars, cafés, schools, parties, and home use.

Replacement nylon mesh filter bag pair for Polaris 360 and 380 pool cleaners. Zippered opening makes emptying debris quicker than velcro closures, and the fine mesh captures leaves, twigs, and sediment. Not designed for Polaris 280 or 480 models. Confirm your model before buying.

specs.included characters: Kion, Fuli, Bunga, Ono, Beshte, Simba, Nala, Rafiki, Timon, Pumbaa

record.description: A ten-piece set of Disney Junior The Lion Guard Pride Lands characters, each about three inches tall and posed in a dynamic action stance. Suited for both imaginative play and display on a shelf or desk.

A lightweight graphic tee with a classic fit and double-needle stitching on the sleeves and bottom hem. Its playful sarcastic text makes it a fun gag gift or holiday present for moms, daughters, aunts, uncles, and grandmas.

A mineral and amino acid plant supplement designed to support flowering and fruit production in hydroponic and other growing setups. It is meant to be used alongside BioThrive bloom fertilizer. Sold in a one-quart container.

specs.care: Not dishwasher safe

record.description: A table napkin holder made from recycled sandcast aluminum, decorated with a sand dollar motif and beaded accents. Created by designer Michael Updike. Hand wash only, since it is not safe for the dishwasher.

specs.closures: Side zipper coin pocket, snap fastener flip cover
specs.RFID: Blocks 13.56 MHz or higher; does not block 125 kHz

record.description: A slim badge holder and wallet combined with a detachable neck lanyard. It has a clear front ID window, four card slots, a zippered coin pocket, and a cash mezzanine. A snap-closed flip cover protects vital cards, and RFID blocking guards against scans at 13.56 MHz and above.

specs.care: Machine washable, tumble dry on low

record.description: A set of four extra-large white bath sheets made from 100% cotton. Each measures 31 by 63 inches and is rated 800 GSM for a plush, absorbent feel. Suited to bathrooms, guest rooms, pools, and beach days. Machine washable and tumble dry on low.

specs.design: Bangtan Boys Love Yourself image permanently dyed into case
specs.features: Openings for buttons and camera lens

record.description: A protective TPU phone case for iPhone models 5 through X, plus 7/8 Plus sizes, featuring a Bangtan Boys Love Yourself design. The image is dyed into the material rather than applied as a sticker. Cutouts give easy access to buttons and the camera lens.

Footed cotton sleeper pajamas for babies in a snug fit, designed for safe overnight wear. The zip-up front makes dressing and changing quick and easy. A dotted pattern adds a playful touch for everyday sleep.

specs.material: Soft, comfortable fabric that resists wrinkling and fading
specs.care: Hand or machine wash, hang dry, do not bleach

record.description: A casual short-sleeve T-shirt dress for girls in a solid white shade that pairs easily with other pieces. Suited to school, parties, beach days, and everyday wear, and it can also serve as a nightgown. Layer it with coats or leggings across all seasons. Hand or machine wash and hang to dry.

specs.washability: Washes off skin and most clothing

record.description: A classroom-sized assortment of 36 watercolor paint sets, made up of basic, glitter, and metallic varieties with eight colors each. Each set comes with a brush, and the washable formula rinses easily from skin and most clothing. The sturdy box has an easy-open lid, making it practical for classrooms, camps, or home use.
A vintage-style graphic t-shirt with a playful taco-themed slogan about not pleasing everyone. It has a lightweight feel and a classic cut, with double-needle stitching on the sleeves and hem.

A four-pack of two-in-one capacitive styluses for touch screens, each with a fine 4.5 mm rubber tip at one end and a 6 mm tip at the other. The tips are replaceable without tools, and 20 spare tips are included. Available in black, blue, purple, and red.

specs.print: Leopard print uppers with white soles
specs.size_range: US Toddler 5M to US Little Kid 3M

record.description: Casual slip-on sneakers for kids with a leopard print canvas upper and white sole. The elastic tongue makes them easy to put on and take off. A rubber sole and a protective toe cap suit running, jumping, and play, and the style pairs well with school or everyday outfits.

specs.polarity: Anode is longer leg, cathode is shorter leg

record.description: Pack of 100 through-hole infrared emitter LEDs with a 5 mm clear round lens, rated for about 850 nm invisible IR output. Two-pin design with the longer leg as anode, suited to remote controls, IR beam sensors, and hobby or DIY electronics projects. Operates at roughly 1.4 to 1.6 volts and 20 mA.

specs.care: Machine washable, tumble dry safe

record.description: A stuffed kitty plush that unfolds into a pullover hoodie, so one toy works as both a cuddly companion and cozy clothing. Made from a soft cotton blend with a full lining, it is machine washable and suited to children aged 2 to 10.

specs.compatibility: GE, Hotpoint, Kenmore ranges and cooktops

record.description: Replacement porcelain drip pans for range cooktops, sold as a four-piece set with two 6-inch and two 8-inch black bowls. Designed to catch drippings and food spills from the surface element. Listing cites compatibility with several GE, Hotpoint, and Kenmore models; check your model before purchase.

specs.fit: Full cut with a roomier fit

record.description: A four-pack of men's short sleeve T-shirts in Light Steel, sized X-Large. Made from a cotton and polyester blend, with a roomier full cut and double-stitched sleeves and hem for everyday wear.
Arrowroot starch sold as a fine, flour-style powder in a 16-ounce package. It can be used for thickening and in baking recipes that call for a starch or flour. Supplied as a single pack.

specs.style: Sleeveless V-neck romper with spaghetti straps
specs.care: Cold water wash, do not bleach, hang or line dry

record.description: A breezy floral romper with a V-neck, sleeveless cut and thin spaghetti straps. Its light, slightly stretchy fabric suits vacations, beach outings, casual days and parties in spring, summer and autumn. Hand washing in cold water and air drying are recommended.

specs.material: Stainless steel wire with colored cotton rope
specs.suitable for: Small and medium parrots and birds

record.description: A two-piece rope bungee perch for parrots and small birds. The flexible wire core wrapped in cotton rope can be bent into different shapes and hung from cage positions. It offers a chewing surface, a place to rest, and a small bell for play. Helps birds exercise and reduces boredom.
Roll of 20 black polyethylene trash bags measuring 46 by 60 centimeters, designed to line household and office trash cans. Sold as a single roll for use as replacement liners or general storage bags.

A rectangular kitchen recycling bin with two 24-liter buckets for sorting trash and recyclables side by side. Its touch bar opens the wide lid from almost any angle, and the lid stays open during food prep or cleaning. Dampers and angled springs keep the lid moving smoothly.

A compact Blu-ray disc player from Panasonic that starts up quickly and plays full 1080p video. It upscales standard and 720p content to 1080p, reads JPEG photos and AVCHD video from SDXC cards or USB devices, and supports single-remote control through VieraLink. Designed to draw less power in use and on standby.

specs.material: Felt upper, faux shearling lining, TPR outsole

record.description: Men's black moccasin-style clog slipper with a soft felt upper and a cozy faux shearling lining. Stretchy elastic goring helps it stay secure. The TPR outsole and compression nodules support indoor and outdoor wear, and the insole can be swapped for an orthotic.

specs.case compatibility: Smooth, hard cases; not silicone, highly textured, or many soft cases

record.description: A collapsible grip that attaches to phones and tablets, helping you hold the device securely for one-handed texting and steadier photos. It folds out into a stand for hands-free video viewing and works with a compatible mount. Adhesion depends on the case: it sticks to smooth, hard cases but not to silicone or heavily textured ones.

A three-pack of stretchy diaper covers in white, sized for babies aged 0 to 6 months. The 4-way stretch fabric is soft and flexible so it moves with the baby, and reinforced snaps are built to hold up to repeated use.

specs.graphic: The Rolling Stones distressed Union Jack design at front

record.description: A men's crew-neck T-shirt in white, featuring a distressed Union Jack graphic with The Rolling Stones branding across the front. Officially licensed merchandise, sized XX-Large.

specs.cushioning: Zone cushioning in heel and toe

record.description: A six-pair pack of women's ankle socks from Hanes. Designed to fit women's shoe sizes 5 to 9, with arch support and targeted cushioning at the heel and toe. Features X-Temp technology said to adapt to body temperature for all-day comfort.

A contemporary overstuffed loveseat with a clean, simple silhouette and track arms. Down-filled cushions offer a deep, comfortable seat, and the removable, reversible seat cushion adds flexibility. The solid hardwood frame and stain-resistant fabric suit everyday living room use.

A soft, comfortable white sundress for girls with a short sleeve and a swingy, twirly hem. The solid color pairs easily with jackets or cardigans and suits summer, spring, and fall wear. Refer to the size chart before ordering.

specs.assembly hardware: T1 bolts x4, washers x4, nuts x4

record.description: A stationary indoor exercise bike for home workouts, with a quiet spinning design. It includes a monitor that tracks time, speed, distance, and calories, with adjustable saddle and handlebar height. Assembly requires attaching the stabilizers, pedals, saddle, and handle with the supplied tools.

Classic white slip-on sneaker for men with a canvas upper and vulcanized rubber outsole. Side gore panels stretch for easy on and off, while a cushioned insole and padded collar add comfort. The breathable lining supports a comfortable everyday fit.

specs.waterproof rating: IPX8, up to 98 ft (30m) in case
specs.included: carrying case, dual charger, 21 mounts and accessories

record.description: Action camera from REMALI that records 4K UHD video and 12MP photos with a 170-degree wide view. Control it with a 2.4G remote from about 30 feet away or through a Wi-Fi smartphone app. An IPX8 case allows underwater use to 98 feet. The kit includes three batteries, a dual charger, a carrying case, and 21 mounts.

A 192-piece mechanics tool set from DEWALT for general mechanical work. It has a polished chrome vanadium finish, hand-stamped markings for easy size identification, and a knurled control ring that gives a firm grip.

specs.model: Men's Nitro Low MC Football Shoe

record.description: Men's low-cut football cleat with a support cage built from coated textile and synthetic overlays for stability and airflow. Features an open-holed mesh tongue for breathability, a molded toe cap for added protection, and a TPU heel clip for support.

Socks decorated with beagle puppies and muddy paw prints on a sky blue background. The cotton, nylon, and spandex blend is sized for U.S. women's shoe sizes 5 to 10.5, making them a playful choice for dog lovers.

specs.ink program: 2 years of Instant Ink included (100 pages/month)
specs.connectivity: Wi-Fi with self-healing, HP Smart app

record.description: A wireless all-in-one inkjet printer for home use that prints, scans, and copies. It offers automatic two-sided printing and can be set up through the HP Smart app. Mobile printing and scanning are supported from smartphones, with document sharing to cloud services.

A 12-inch magnetic vinyl emblem celebrating the University of Georgia Bulldogs. It sticks to metal surfaces such as a car's body, so fans can show team pride on the go. The heavy gauge vinyl is printed with the team logo and colors.
Hunter is a nail polish from the Zoya brand, packaged in a 0.5 fluid ounce bottle. It is designed for applying color to fingernails, giving a polished look for manicures and everyday nail care.

A men's laptop backpack from Hurley with a large main compartment that includes a laptop sleeve. It has a front pocket with an internal organizer, a mesh side pocket sized for most water bottles, and a water resistant coated base. Holds about 21 liters.

A lightweight Nike running shoe for young kids, with a mesh upper for breathability and a hook-and-loop closure for a secure fit without laces. Soft foam cushions the foot and a cushioned heel adds comfort. The rubber outsole has flex grooves for natural movement and everyday or athletic wear.

specs.valve type: 3-way T valve with shut-off and ceramic valve
specs.included: T adapter, 2 cone washers, filter screen washer, hose connector

record.description: A brass T adapter with a shut-off valve that splits a toilet fill line to feed a bidet sprayer while the toilet keeps its normal water flow. The valve can shut off or reduce water pressure to the bidet. A filter screen washer helps catch sediment. Designed for most American 7/8 inch toilet connections.

specs.material: Steel frame with powder coated finish; particle board top
specs.assembly: Required; step-by-step instructions and hardware included

record.description: A 55-inch home office computer desk with a powder-coated steel frame and particle board top in an espresso finish. Two grommets help keep cords tidy, and adjustable glides help it sit level on uneven floors. Assembly is required, with instructions and hardware provided.

specs.handle: Clickable lever that engages by clicking up and down

record.description: A commercial-grade keg coupler for American D System Sankey kegs, letting you pour domestic draft beer directly from the keg. Its stainless steel construction resists chemicals and holds up to heavy use in bars, pubs, and restaurants. The clickable lever engages the keg without pulling it out first, and a 55 psi release valve vents pressure easily.

specs.lighting: LED headlights and RGB LED lights

record.description: A self-balancing hoverboard with 6.5-inch wheels, UL2272 certification, and a built-in Bluetooth speaker. It has LED lights for night riding and a non-slip foot pad design. Suited to riders from 44 to 220 pounds, it is meant for learning quickly and riding for fun.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: A woven falsa blanket from Mexico, suited to yoga practice or cozying up on the sofa during winter. Its soft, thick weave is made from acrylic-treated cotton and can be machine washed. Each piece is handmade, so shade may vary slightly.

specs.glasses: two 8 oz heavy bottom lowball glasses

record.description: A gift set for New Orleans Saints fans who enjoy whiskey. It includes two heavy-bottomed lowball glasses, two sandstone coasters, and six soapstone stones meant to chill drinks without diluting them. The solid oak box holds all the pieces securely for storage or gifting.

specs.care: Wash inside out with cold water

record.description: A vintage-style American flag t-shirt in navy blue, made from a cotton blend for a comfortable, modern fit. Suited to patriotic occasions such as the Fourth of July, it also makes a thoughtful gift for anyone who loves the USA. Wash inside out in cold water.

specs.features: Misting function, neon light, USB port

record.description: A compact handheld fan with a built-in water tank that can mist for cooling. It offers three speeds, a rechargeable battery, and a head that rotates 180 degrees and folds for easy carrying on a bag or desk.

A single-DIN car stereo with Bluetooth for hands-free calls and wireless music playback. It offers FM radio with station presets, USB, AUX and memory card inputs, a built-in EQ with preset curves, and a wireless remote. The display features multicolor LED lighting. Confirm fit for your dashboard before buying.

specs.compatibility: MacBook Pro 2016/2017, MacBook Air, Galaxy S8, Chromebook Pixel

record.description: A compact USB-C to HDMI adapter that streams Ultra HD video up to 4096 x 2160 at 60Hz. Its foldable, nylon-braided cable stays tidy in a laptop sleeve and travels easily. Designed to fit beside an Apple charging cable, it works with select MacBook, Galaxy, and Chromebook models.

A flexible single-face corrugated cardboard roll for wrapping fragile items. Its raised A-flute layer offers shock-absorbing cushioning and crush resistance, and it conforms to varied shapes. Suited to protecting metal and glass parts. Made from recyclable material.

A self-propelled gas lawn mower suited to smaller yards and tight spaces. It offers side discharge, mulching, and rear bagging, with a rear wheel drive mode for uneven ground. The steel deck cuts a 20-inch swath across eight height settings.

A wire-free everyday bra from Hanes with lightweight fabric meant to feel close to the skin. A comfort band is designed to keep it in place, and flexible foam cups add shape and support. Its sleek design is intended to stay largely hidden under clothing.

specs.handle: 6-inch hand strap with rivet-reinforced leather attachments

record.description: A handmade lunch bag of waxed canvas with an insulated lining and a carry handle for packing lunch to work, school, or a picnic. Its interior wipes clean and dries easily, and the bag stands nine inches tall with room for a hearty meal.

specs.care: Surface washable

record.description: A plush unicorn toy with a soft white body, a vivid purple mane and tail, and a shimmery patterned horn. Weighted hooves help it stand upright. The surface can be wiped clean, making it a gentle companion for young children.

A four-piece twin bedding set in navy, made from long staple cotton with a sateen weave and a 500 thread count. Includes a flat sheet, fitted sheet with deep pockets, and two pillowcases. Machine washable for simple care.

specs.case limit: Phones with cases thicker than 5 mm may not charge
specs.adapter: QC2.0 or QC3.0 car adapter needed for 7.5W/10W, not included
specs.compatibility: iPhone 11 to 13 series, Samsung Galaxy S8 to S21, Note 10/20

record.description: A car mount that fits a cup holder and grips your phone automatically once it is placed inside. An adjustable aluminum arm helps you see the screen while driving. It offers wireless Qi charging that adjusts power between 5W and 10W, with a status indicator and overvoltage and temperature protection. Use a QC2.0 or QC3.0 car adapter for fastest charging.
A long-sleeve girls' dress for toddlers, made from a cotton and polyester jersey blend. It has an allover fair isle pattern, a crew neckline, and an elasticized waist for easy pull-on wear.

specs.product type: Side table / end table / coffee table

record.description: A compact square side table with a lower shelf for extra storage, suited to small rooms. It goes together without much effort and has a steel tube frame for stability. The brown wood-grain finish wipes clean easily.

specs.use: Cleaning and storage of glass water pipes and rigs
specs.function: Seals openings for cleaning and transport

record.description: Universal plugs and caps designed to fit a wide range of glass pipe and rig joints, both male and female. Used with a cleaning solution, they help make cleaning glass water pipes quicker and simpler. The snug seal may also help contain odors during storage and transport. The set includes two medium plugs and one large plug.

A golf swing training aid for men that uses a guided grip with thumb and index finger positioning to build muscle memory. It is designed to support a controlled release motion aimed at improving distance, accuracy, and tempo. The right-hand model measures 38 inches and has a red finish.

specs.material: Fiber-reinforced polycarbonate and stainless steel hardware
specs.type: Dual tray for two lights or flashes

record.description: A dual tray for underwater cameras that holds two lights or flashes at once to add brightness, reduce shadows, and steady the setup. It attaches to standard 1/4-20 tripod mounts and includes a mounting knob for quick installation.
Single clear acrylic taper ear gauge plug, 12mm (1/2 inch), with glitter and a pink heart pattern. Sold individually, so buy two for a matching pair. Comes with two rubber O-rings.

specs.material: E1 standard wood panel, metal frame
specs.assembly: 4 legs with hex key, about 5-10 minutes

record.description: A spacious 63-inch writing desk for home or office, with a simple square work surface and room for a computer, printer, and other devices. The wood panel has a scratch-resistant surface that wipes clean easily, and the metal frame gives solid support. Adjustable legs help it sit steady on uneven floors. It is designed to meet BIFMA standards.

specs.use: Display in kitchen, dining room, curio cabinet or shelf

record.description: A set of six clear display easels for showing a teacup and saucer. Each stand holds one cup with its saucer set behind it, so both pieces stay visible. Suited to collectible dishware on a kitchen shelf, dining room, or curio cabinet. Also a fitting gift for someone who collects tableware.

A set of eight black compression socks for women and men, rated 15-20 mmHg. The blend of nylon, polyester and elastane aims to balance comfort with a snug grip, and the fabric is designed to breathe and wick moisture. Suited to long days on your feet, travel, running and other fitness activities.

specs.material: Solid polished brass bell with wood handle

record.description: A large vintage-style school bell with a solid polished brass body and a wooden handle. It serves both as a decorative piece and as a working bell for classrooms, events, or gatherings. Measuring about 12 inches tall and 5.5 inches long, it offers a classic look.

Long-sleeve fishing tee from Columbia's PFG line, made from quick-drying polyester interlock. Built-in UPF 50 sun protection and moisture-wicking fabric help keep you cool and dry on the water. Classic-fit cut designed for comfort on any outdoor adventure.

A pack of ten black gel ink pens with a fine 0.38 mm tip for everyday writing, note-taking, and marking calendars. The pigment-based ink is designed to write smoothly and is noted as waterproof and fade-resistant.

specs.material: 300GSM cardboard, plastic window, natural jute twine

record.description: Fourteen black bakery boxes with an openable plastic window, suited for cupcakes, macarons, cookies and other treats. Each box is made of sturdy cardboard and folds together without tools. A jute twine bundle is included for wrapping and carrying. Useful for party favors, birthdays and holiday gatherings, with a blank area on the surface for custom decoration.

specs.style: Ripped bib overall shorts with raw hem

record.description: Women's blue denim bib overall shorts with distressed details and a cuffed raw hem. Adjustable straps with metal buckles offer a flexible fit. Lightweight, soft, and breathable with some stretch. Suited to casual days, outings, and summer travel.

Sparkling stud earrings set with princess-cut cubic zirconia and a cushion-shaped halo. The sterling silver base has a rhodium finish. A small, simple design that suits everyday wear or special occasions. Comes with a drawstring pouch for storage or gifting.

Downloadable will-making kit for US residents that walks you through creating a will to distribute assets, name beneficiaries, and appoint a guardian for minor children. Includes a preprinted sample form for use as a rough draft. Product registration is required to access the current forms and instructions. Usable in all 50 states.

specs.included: Steamer, airplane, car, police car puzzles
specs.packaging: Cloth carrying pouch and gift box

record.description: A wooden jigsaw set of four vehicle puzzles for toddlers aged one to three. Each puzzle shows a cute vehicle in bright colors, with thick, smooth-edged pieces that are easy for small hands to grip. Helps build hand-eye coordination, concentration, and color recognition during play at home or outdoors.

Low-profile semi-flush ceiling fan with an integrated LED light and remote control. The 7-blade fan offers three speeds, and the light adjusts in brightness and across three color temperatures. A sleep mode provides soft warm light for nighttime use. Suits bedrooms, kitchens, and studies.

A crystal flush mount ceiling light with two bulb sockets and a chrome-finished metal dome that resists rust. Its 143 K9 crystal balls catch and reflect light, making it a focal point for entryways, hallways, dining rooms, and bedrooms. Dimmable with compatible bulbs.

A sterling silver halo engagement ring with a round clear cubic zirconia center stone surrounded by micro-pavé stones that continue along the band. Rhodium-plated finish, sized 7, and presented in a leather box. Suitable as an engagement, wedding, or anniversary gift.

specs.compatibility: iPhone 11, iPhone 11 Pro, iPhone 11 Pro Max

record.description: A wallet-style flip case for iPhone 11, 11 Pro, and 11 Pro Max. Its slim shell has a soft inner layer and card slots for a few IDs and some cash, so you can leave your wallet at home. Cutouts give access to buttons, camera, speaker, and charging port. A built-in stand supports viewing video or video calls.

specs.window type: Casement, bottom hung, or skylight (not sliding)
specs.closure: Zipper with Velcro-style adhesive hook tape
specs.care: Water resistant and washable

record.description: A window seal kit for portable air conditioners and tumble dryers, placed around an open casement-style window. A zipper wraps around the exhaust hose so warm air returning through the side gaps is blocked. Mounts with adhesive hook tape, requires no wall drilling, and can be removed and stored when not in use.

specs.material: Absorbent polyester fabric with waterproof backing
specs.care: Machine washable; do not bleach

record.description: A low-profile drying mat for kitchen counters that soaks up water from dishes, glassware, and produce while its waterproof backing guards the surface beneath. The slip-resistant base keeps it in place, and it can be trimmed with scissors to fit different spaces. Machine washable and made in the USA.

specs.type: Solar panel battery charger for trail cameras

record.description: Solar charger battery that provides backup power to compatible Suntek hunting and game trail cameras. Includes overload and overdischarge protection, mounts to a tree, pole, or Moultrie tripod, and is designed for indoor and outdoor use.

Men's mesh shorts built for training and everyday activity. The breathable mesh construction promotes airflow, while moisture-wicking fabric helps keep you comfortable. An elastic waistband with an internal draw cord allows an adjustable fit, and side pockets hold small essentials.

A slim-fitting white long-sleeve top with a cross-wrap front and asymmetrical neckline in soft ribbed knit. Its stretchy blend suits casual or going-out looks, pairing easily with pants, skirts, shorts, or jeans. Runs small, so check the size chart for bust measurements.

specs.wheel feature: LEDs light up as wheels turn, no batteries

record.description: Clip-on heel wheels that turn ordinary shoes into roller skates for kids. Built-in LEDs in the wheels glow as they spin, so no batteries are needed. The lightweight design adjusts to fit a range of shoes and includes a rubber strap and larger brakes for stopping. Recommended for ages 6 and up.

A thin white matte tape for drawing straight, even lines on charts, crafts, decorations, and signs. Its permanent adhesive holds on plastic, glass, paper, wood, metal, and ceramic, for indoor or outdoor use on clean, dry surfaces.

specs.assembled dimensions: 54.53 L x 29.92 W x 18.90 H inches

record.description: A wooden toddler bed with a PAW Patrol theme, built for children from about 15 months up. Two high side rails help keep little sleepers safe during the move to a big kid bed. The bed is designed for simple assembly and is JPMA certified to meet CPSC and ASTM safety standards.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle; tumble dry; do not bleach

record.description: A pair of solid ivory sheer curtain panels with a textured linen-style look. Each panel has eight silver grommets for easy hanging on a rod. The sheer weave lets in soft daylight while offering some privacy and airflow, suited to bedrooms, living rooms, and other spaces.

specs.included: 2 magnets, marker with eraser, self-stick pads, mounting magnets

record.description: A small dry erase whiteboard with a magnetic surface for notes, lists, dates, and drawings. It can also hold photos and messages with the included magnets. The lightweight aluminum frame has a clean, minimal look and can hang horizontally or vertically.

specs.closure: Zip lock seal with 2 blue sealing clips
specs.care: Hand wash and air dry; not for microwave, oven, or dishwasher

record.description: Reusable food storage bags in a 12-piece set for lunches, snacks, sandwiches, and freezer use. Made from BPA-free PEVA with a leakproof zip seal and transparent sides so contents are easy to see. Hand wash and air dry. Avoid storing hot foods.
A seven-piece set of long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls, sized 18 months and sold in an assorted pack. The snaps are built to hold up through frequent washing and everyday wear.

specs.key ingredients: Amla fruit extract, white tea extract, hyaluronic acid, plant ceramides

record.description: A vanilla plant-based protein powder meant to support the body's own collagen building. Blended with amla fruit extract, amino acids, and plant proteins, it can be mixed into shakes, smoothies, or coffee. Labeled non-GMO, gluten-free, dairy-free, and vegan-friendly.

Refill bulbs for Bath & Body Works Wallflowers plug-in fragrance warmers, in a sweet cinnamon pumpkin scent with notes of butter and vanilla cream. A set of six bulbs packed as three twin-packs. Compatible with Wallflower plugs and night-lights. This fragrance has been discontinued.

specs.origin: Eastern Europe (e.g., Russia, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, Ukraine)
specs.contents: Candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, pretzels, and more

record.description: A mixed box of pre-packaged snacks from Eastern European countries. Each box may include a varied selection of candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, and pretzels. Contents vary from box to box, and the photos show example items.

specs.fitment: Manual and automatic vehicles without button shifters
specs.package: 1 shifter knob, 3 rubber adapters, 1 hex spanner, 4 metal screws

record.description: A skull-themed gear shift knob with a black resin head and aluminum alloy attachment. Three adapters suit shifter rods of different diameters. Intended for manual and automatic cars without a shift-lock button. Installation takes a few minutes using the included spanner and screws.

specs.use: Vase filler, table scatter, event decoration

record.description: A set of 200 ivory faux plastic pearls with polished, smooth surfaces and no drilled holes, sized in three diameters. Includes six packets of transparent water gels that help the pearls float in vases. Suited to weddings, showers, anniversaries, and home decor, and reusable for multiple events.

specs.product type: Travel system stroller and infant car seat bundle
specs.included items: Modes Bassinet Stroller, SnugRide SnugLock 35 Infant Car Seat
specs.configurations: 3 strollers in 1: infant bassinet, infant car seat carrier, toddler stroller
specs.seat pad care: Spot clean with mild soap and warm water
specs.car seat attachment: Click Connect, one-step attachment to stroller frame

record.description: A travel system bundle from Graco pairing a Modes stroller with a SnugRide SnugLock 35 infant car seat. The stroller works as a bassinet, a car seat carrier, or a toddler stroller, and the toddler seat rides rear- or forward-facing as a child grows.

specs.dimensions: 22.25 in L x 6.5 in W x 1 in H

record.description: A white plastic tray sized to sit under 24-inch flower boxes, helping to protect decks, patios, or indoor surfaces. Made from lightweight plastic that resists fading. The tray is sold alone; flower boxes are not included. Made in the USA.

specs.dimensions: 10.25 x 16 x 5.5 inches (L x W x H)
specs.material: Steel with rust resistant plastic coat
specs.included: Undershelf basket with snug fit arms

record.description: A medium wire undershelf basket that hooks onto cabinet shelves to add a second storage level below. Its steel frame has a rust resistant coating, and it suits spices, napkins, small boxes, and kitchen utensils. Snug fit arms attach it to cabinets, countertops, or under other shelves.

specs.chain: Optional 18 in curb link chain (sold with or without)

record.description: A small heart-shaped locket with room for two photos, finished in 24k gold plating. Available with or without a fine 18-inch curb link chain. Arrives in a black velvet pouch, making it a simple gift option for women and girls.

specs.length: 13 cm with cap posted, 10.5 cm capped
specs.origin: Hand-made and inspected in Nuremberg, Germany

record.description: A compact fountain pen with a brass body in classic Kaweco styling. It has a fine gold-plated steel nib for a smooth, soft writing feel. Light enough to carry in a pocket, it is assembled by hand in Nuremberg.

Pre-made blue volume lash extensions designed for lash technicians who are new to hand-made volume work. A sticky base strip helps keep each fan from separating, so fans can be formed quickly. Lengths run from 14 to 20mm at 0.07mm thickness. Intended for salon and training use.

A wall-mounted coat rack with five metal hooks for hanging coats, hats, bags, and umbrellas. Its distressed wood frame gives a rustic look that suits many decors. Mounting hardware is included, and the rack is rated to hold up to 30 pounds. Suitable for entryways, kitchens, and bedrooms.

specs.load capacity: 200 pounds or more when installed properly
specs.use: Drying fishing and hunting waders and wader boots

record.description: A stainless steel chain hanger for drying and storing fishing waders, chest waders, waist waders, hunting waders, and wader boots. Hang them in a closet or from a tree branch to keep them off the ground and help them hold their shape.

specs.exterior: Bonded fleece with grid knit texture

record.description: A men's full-zip jacket from Spyder with a grid-knit bonded fleece exterior and a Sherpa fleece lining. It has two side zip pockets and an embroidered Spyder logo on the front. Suited to cool-weather layering, or worn under an insulated shell in colder conditions.

specs.dimensions: 23 in high x 16 in wide x 25 in long

record.description: A pet stair that helps dogs reach couches and higher beds without a hard jump. Its gentle incline lowers the number of steps needed to climb. Suitable for small, medium, and large dogs, it has a carpeted tread that comes off for simple cleaning.

specs.type: Multifunction pen (black and red ballpoint, 0.5mm pencil, stylus, eraser)
specs.engraving: 25 characters included, deep cut, silver color fill

record.description: A slim multifunction pen with a twist mechanism that switches between black ballpoint, red ballpoint, and pencil. Includes a stylus on the cap and a hidden eraser. Satin black finish with chrome accents. Personalized engraving of a name or short message is included, and the pen ships in a gift box.

specs.care: Machine washable, pre-shrunk

record.description: A black short-sleeve t-shirt with a football fan graphic celebrating loyalty to a team. Made of 100% cotton, pre-shrunk, and machine washable for easy care. Screen printed in the USA.

Casual sandals for kids with a soft EVA footbed that offers arch support and a flexible, cushioned feel. The vegan leather strap has a jersey lining to reduce rubbing. The molded outsole provides grip on a variety of surfaces.

specs.features: Mesh underarm inserts, sweat-wicking Climalite fabric

record.description: A white home jersey for Real Madrid fans, made from recycled polyester. It has a relaxed, straight cut, short sleeves, and a crew neckline. Mesh underarm panels and moisture-wicking fabric help keep the wearer comfortable, and a woven club crest finishes the look.

HDTV cable made for Saturn consoles, letting owners connect to compatible high-definition televisions. It supports 720p output and comes with a 7-foot main cable plus a 6-foot micro cable in the package.

specs.fit: Oakley Holbrook frames, model numbers starting with OO9102, 55mm size

record.description: Replacement lenses for Oakley Holbrook sunglasses with a dark silver mirror coating and polarization to reduce glare. Designed to fit 55mm frames with model numbers starting with OO9102. Lenses are impact resistant and offer UV protection. Frame not included; the pack contains two lenses.

specs.upper: Fabric straps with soft nubuck toe post
specs.footbed: Molded EVA with arch support, heel cup, and toe bar

record.description: Women's thong-style sandal from Bionica suited to beach days and time by the water. A soft nubuck toe post sits between fabric straps, and a quick-drying molded footbed offers arch support and a heel cup. A cushioned midsole and slip-resistant rubber outsole add comfort and grip.

specs.care: Dishwasher safe

record.description: A heavy, sturdy feeding bowl for large dogs. The rubber base grips slick floors such as tile and linoleum to limit sliding during meals. Assorted colors are offered, and the bowl can be cleaned in a dishwasher.

A wall poster featuring LEGO Batman in a grid design, printed from high-resolution artwork. Sized for most rooms, it arrives unframed and can be framed or hung with clips, pins, or poster mounts. Suits kids' rooms, playrooms, dorms, and office walls.

specs.colors: Blue Stripe, Orange Gators, Gray Stripe

record.description: Sleeveless toddler boys' tank tops sold as a three-pack in blue striped, orange gator, and gray striped designs. Features a ribbed neckline and a small pocket detail. Tagless packaging for easy wear.

specs.shipping: Sold and shipped flat in pallet quantities

record.description: Large double wall corrugated kraft container bottom for consolidating multiple-piece shipments and protecting bulky, irregularly shaped items. Sold in packs of 75, shipped flat on pallets. Pairs with a matching Gaylord lid.

specs.dimensions: 13.8 x 6.7 x 3.2 inches (H x L x W)
specs.features: USB charging port (power bank not included), earphone side hole

record.description: A compact black sling bag made of water-resistant PU leather with adjustable nylon straps. It can be worn across the chest or over one shoulder and has two main compartments plus a front zip pocket for small essentials. An external USB port and side hole for earphone cable add everyday convenience.

specs.design: older woman and young girl holding hands

record.description: A hand-painted resin figurine showing an older woman in a cream dress seated on a gray bench beside a young girl in a cream dress, holding hands. Designed to celebrate the bond between grandparent and child, it can stand alone or join other pieces in a family grouping. Comes in a fitted box for gift-giving.

specs.blade_style: Replaceable wire cutters, spring-action scissors, four outside-opening blades

record.description: A heavy-duty multitool with 21 tools built around large pliers, long blades, and all-locking features. Replaceable wire cutters and a blade exchanger make it adaptable, and one-hand opening reaches every tool. Includes a lanyard ring and a nylon sheath for carrying.

specs.includes: Matching chef hat with velcro fastener
specs.fit: Select size by bust measurement in size chart

record.description: A short-sleeved chef's coat for women in white, designed to be worn double-breasted with ten buttons. A matching white chef hat with a velcro fastener is included, and the hat is said to fit a range of sizes. Choose your size by bust measurement using the size chart.

specs.care: Hand wash with cool water, do not machine wash or dry in sunlight

record.description: Neoprene gloves for snorkeling, kayaking, surfing, and other water sports. The 3MM material offers warmth and a flexible, form-fitting feel, while the textured palm helps you keep a firm grip on small items. An adjustable velcro strap at the wrist keeps out sand and debris. Not fully waterproof; designed to be worn with a wetsuit.

specs.care: Machine washable cold, tumble dry low

record.description: Casual denim shortalls with a cuffed hem, multiple pockets, adjustable straps, and a center front zipper. Blended with LYCRA for stretch. Machine washable in cold water and tumble dry on low.

specs.ports: 4 USB 3.0 ports plus USB-C charging port

record.description: A compact USB-C multiport hub that adds four USB 3.0 ports for keyboards, mice, flash drives and hard drives. It passes through up to 60W of power to a compatible laptop, with an aluminum body and an LED indicator. Plug-and-play use on many USB-C laptops and tablets, though some older or limited USB-C ports may not support all functions.

Poster titled Oversoul by artist Alex Grey, measuring 18 by 24 inches. Offered as a museum-quality print and an official Alex Grey item. The accompanying text connects human awareness with both planetary and cosmic awareness.

A foldable outdoor rocking chair with a powder-coated steel frame and breathable mesh seat. Its low-profile rocker locks in place for steady rocking and reclining. A shoulder bag is included for easy carrying and storage. Supports up to 300 pounds.

Officially licensed batteries from the Child's Play 2 film, sold as a two-pack of size D cells. Intended as a movie-themed accessory for a Good Guys doll, and based on the film's onscreen and behind-the-scenes imagery. A collectible tie-in for fans of the franchise.
